title: Skill-Constrained Model Predictive Control for Resilient Manufacturing Supply Chains
summary: In skill-constrained production-inventory systems, the qualified human capacity available tomorrow depends on training decisions made today: production requires certified workers, certifications decay unless maintained, and training consumes the same scarce worker hours that production needs now. We study a closed-loop skill-constrained model predictive controller that, at every shift, solves a finite-horizon mixed-integer program over production, inventory, backlog, and training, with binary predicted certification, hard production eligibility, and an interpretable terminal value that prices certified-capacity gaps at the horizon boundary; only the first-period action is applied before replanning. On synthetic, seed-controlled SkillChain-Gym scenarios - announced and surprise new-skill shocks, demand shocks, absenteeism, forecast- and availability-quality modes, capacity-boundary and training-rate sweeps, and negative controls - we evaluate the controller against production-only and maintenance-only ablations, static cross-training insurance plans, and a strong reactive heuristic, under an ex-ante locked configuration and paired statistics. The result is regime dependence, not superiority: no policy class dominates. Predictive control helps when skill or labor bottlenecks are forecastable early enough for training to complete; lean static insurance remains hard to beat under surprise shocks, near the demand-capacity boundary, and wherever pre-shock slack makes insurance cheap. Attribution ablations separate certification maintenance, re-acquisition of lapsed certifications, and greenfield skill acquisition. Forecastability, not adaptivity per se, decides when predictive control pays.

title: Syntactic Systems Cannot See Semantic Invariants
summary: We start from a small open question, where Hetzl and Vierling asked whether two theories of induction, open induction and clause set cycles, are incomparable. They proved one direction and left the other open. Here we close it, and the proof is almost embarrassingly short, because the rules for addition can only fire when the first argument is $0$ or a successor, a Skolem constant is neither, so the terms $a{+}b$ and $b{+}a$ can never be touched, and a machine that can never touch them can never prove they are equal. The thing that separates the two theories is the order of two constants, and that order is a fact about numbers, not about symbols. We extract from this proof a small general principle, the Syntactic Invariance Principle, that names the shape of such arguments. We then close with a few speculative remarks on how this same shape appears, informally, in the known barriers to settling $\mathsf{P}$ versus $\mathsf{NP}$, where each barrier seems to point to a level of description that the techniques in the barrier cannot reach. We raise this as a suggestion rather than a theorem, since the analogy is real but we do not push it past the point where we can defend it. Along the way we raise an open question that the analogy suggests but does not settle, on whether a fast algorithm for $\SAT$, were it to exist, would always be exhibitable as a machine you can write down or whether it could be found, in some cases, only as a function on the numbers.

title: On the Memorization Behavior of LLMs in Generative Recommendation: Observations, Implications, and Training Strategies
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising direction for recommender systems. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been increasingly adopted for GR, as their rich pretrained knowledge is expected to help them generalize beyond common user behavior patterns that traditional memorization-oriented baselines can capture. However, existing LLM-based GR works largely ignore LLMs' well-known tendency to memorize, which, if present in LLMs fine-tuned for GR, would restrict their utilization of pretrained knowledge. In this work, we investigate this concern by examining one-hop memorization, where a model recommends items that are direct successors of items in the training data. We show that LLMs do this more than non-LLM-based GR models-in fact, the vast majority of their gains over GR baselines are actually on users whose target items can be predicted through one-hop memorization. We intuit that improving performance on the remaining users requires LLMs to learn richer item-item relations beyond one-hop transitions. To achieve this, we propose IIRG, a novel training strategy that teaches LLMs to capture: (1) collaborative relations derived from item co-occurrences across multiple hops in user sequences, and (2) semantic relations among items with similar themes, both of which can serve as useful recommendation signals. We show that IIRG significantly improves over LLMs trained solely with standard next-item prediction, with especially large gains for users whose test items are not covered by train-time one-hop transitions.

title: Training LLMs with Reinforcement Learning over Digital Twin Representations for Reasoning-Intensive Surgical VideoQA
summary: Surgical video question answering requires multi-step reasoning across semantic, spatial, and temporal dimensions. Existing methods architecturally compress videos into discrete token representations and couple visual perception with reasoning. This approach fragments continuous spatial-temporal relationships and has been shown to restrict multi-step reasoning capabilities. We introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that trains large language models (LLMs) to decouple perception from reasoning by operating over digital twin representations constructed from surgical foundation models. Additionally, we introduce hierarchical representations across frame, temporal window, and procedure levels with probabilistic uncertainty estimates. Finally, we propose a novel reward that combines format validation with accuracy assessment through clinical plausibility evaluation and uncertainty-aware calibration for training. To demonstrate the capabilities of this approach, we introduce REAL-Colon-Reason, a colonoscopic benchmark with 2000 question-answer pairs across three complexity levels. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on REAL-Colon-Reason and two existing surgical VideoQA benchmarks REAL-Colon-VQA and EndoVis18-VQA.

title: Optimal Powered Descent Guidance with Pyramid-Shaped Approach-Angle Constraints
comments: This work has been submitted for journal publication. 36 pages 10 figures
summary: In this paper, a novel optimal soft-landing guidance law with inequality approach-angle path constraints is analytically derived. The proposed guidance law prevents ground collision and enables approach-angle control by constraining the optimal trajectory to remain within a convex inverted pyramid originating at the landing point. A 3D point-mass linear kinematic model in a constant gravitational field is employed, together with a quadratic control-effort cost and terminal constraints on position and velocity. Analytical open-loop and closed-loop solutions, together with the optimal final time, are derived using Pontryagin's Minimum Principle and the optimality conditions at the transitions between unconstrained and constrained arcs. It is additionally shown that the optimal final time decreases when the path constraints become active. The resulting guidance law is continuous, piecewise linear in time, and nonlinear in the states in closed-loop. When a constraint becomes active, the controller cancels the gravitational component normal to the constraint, causing the trajectory to evolve along the constraint surface. The proposed guidance law is evaluated in simulations under various initial conditions, demonstrating accurate landing performance and consistent satisfaction of the path constraints.

title: Are you speaking my languages? On spoken language adherence in multimodal LLMs
comments: 7 pages, 3 tables in the main body
summary: While Large Language Model (LLM) based Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) enables seamless multilingual use, models often misidentify the output language, compromising transcription fidelity and downstream application quality. To preserve flexibility and code-switching capabilities, we propose a soft prompting approach that hints at potential spoken languages without strictly constraining the output. We formally define this challenge as a lack of language adherence, introduce a novel metric to quantify violations, and evaluate three mitigation strategies: (1) zero-shot prompting for robust guidance under uncertainty, (2) supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to improve prompt adherence, and (3) Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to enforce adherence during decoding. We present a comparative analysis of these methods across multiple languages, evaluating effectiveness in reducing the language violation while maintaining overall ASR performance. Finally, we discuss trade-offs to guide strategy selection under various compute constraints.

title: ARVO: Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities for Open-Source Software
comments: Accepted at IEEE European Symposium on Security and Privacy (EuroS&P) 2026
summary:
Achieving reproducibility, quantity, and diversity in vulnerability datasets has long been viewed as an inherent three-way trade-off, where improving one dimension often comes at the cost of the others. In practice, reproducibility has been the dimension most often neglected. This has limited what can be automatically extracted from historical bug datasets, and has reduced their utility for downstream security research.
  In this work, we propose a method to produce a new security dataset which ensures reproducibility for diverse vulnerabilities at scale by identifying the key obstacles to large-scale bug reproduction and addressing them with general solutions. Using this method, we introduce full reproducibility to the largest open source software vulnerability dataset (OSS-Fuzz) and construct the ARVO dataset (an Atlas of Reproducible Vulnerabilities in Open-source software). ARVO is a large-scale dataset consisting of over 6,100 real-world vulnerabilities across 311 projects. Focusing on reproducibility, ARVO differs from existing datasets by providing each vulnerability in a form that can be consistently rebuilt, triggered, and analyzed across versions. Reproducibility also enables automatic identification of the corresponding patch for each vulnerability and supports direct interaction with vulnerabilities after code changes, capabilities that existing large-scale datasets do not provide. In our evaluation, ARVO successfully reproduces 81% of vulnerabilities and achieves 89.4% accuracy on the located patches. We also discuss ARVO's influence on both upstream practices and downstream security research.

title: From Democracies to Autocracies: How AI Systems Enable Authoritarianism by Design
summary: AI-enabled authoritarianism is not confined to autocracies. In this paper, we provide greater transparency by investigating and mapping the lifecycles of six AI systems deployed in different political regimes, ranging from the US to China. By drawing on an extensive range of sources (academic publications, investigative research reports, third-party evaluations, media interviews, government procurement notices), we conduct a systematic, qualitative comparison across systems to identify the critical technical and operational features that enable authoritarianism within their respective political contexts. We find that enabling features include the centralization and co-optation of administrative data for law enforcement and political punishment, regulatory gaps that fail to deter misuse, weak user compliance that nullifies human oversight mechanisms, and the encoding of protected group traits that identify members of vulnerable populations. We find that these features are present across systems deployed in autocratic and democratic regimes, albeit in varying configurations. We also find that both centralized and fragmented AI systems can contribute to authoritarianism by exploiting governance gaps: centralized systems directed by executive authorities, particularly within security and military institutions, are often not subjected to formal oversight mechanisms, while fragmented systems diffuse accountability between stakeholders, paving the way for entrenchment. These findings reveal that AI-enabled authoritarianism is distributed, resulting from design and operational choices made by developers, administrators, and users alike. We conclude with recommendations for developers and policymakers to mitigate these risks.

title: Local Fault Repair of Perfect Resource Placements in Eisenstein--Jacobi Networks
comments: Submitted to Journal of Parallel and Distributed Computing (JPDC). Preprint also available on Zenodo:https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20690942
summary: Perfect resource placements in dense Eisenstein--Jacobi (EJ) networks partition the network into hexagonal radius-$t$ service cells. This paper studies local repair of such placements after resource failures. For one failed resource, we prove that one replacement cannot cover the failed hexagon and two always suffice, giving $ρ_{\mathrm{EJ}}(t)=2$ for all $t\ge1$. Among minimum-size repairs, the sharp minimum-overlap formula $Ω_{\mathrm{EJ}}(t)=t^2$ follows from the three-strip geometry of EJ balls. For two failed resources, independent repair gives a four-replacement upper bound, but unlike the Gaussian case EJ repair is not always additive: two infinite neighboring displacement families admit three-replacement repairs, proved optimal by a two-ball impossibility argument. Additive behavior is established algebraically via endpoint-rigidity and diagonal-corridor theorems. For $q$ failed resources, independent canonical repair gives a universal $2q$ upper bound, exact when failed cells are pairwise more than $4t$ apart. Dense cluster subadditivity is proved for infinite four-fault and six-fault families with exact repair numbers four and five, giving savings of four and seven over independent repair. An exact inclusion--exclusion identity governs repeated coverage for arbitrary multi-fault repairs. An audit over 19,400 instances confirms widespread subadditivity. EJ local repair is structurally distinct from the Gaussian case: the one-fault overlap is quadratic, two-fault repair can be non-additive, and clustered repairs reuse replacement balls across multiple failed cells.

title: Nothing from Something: Can a Language Model Discover 0?
summary: AI systems based on artificial neural networks are being developed with aspirations of pushing the boundary of human mathematical knowledge. A key question for these systems is how much they can reach beyond their training data. Mathematical discovery requires a strong form of out of distribution generalization; the ability to hypothesize genuinely new - and potentially logically more powerful - mathematical structures. It has been hypothesized that language abilities support such generalizations in human cognition. In this work, we use simple arithmetic as a case study for examining how modern AI models could expand their mathematical horizons, evaluating whether these models can independently discover the concept of "zero". We show that We show that (1) language models of a GPT-2 size are unable to perform this generalization at test time regardless of language pretraining, but (2) models can improve substantially after training on tens or hundreds of examples of zero. Additionally, we find that language pretraining reduces the number of required examples by approximately $50\%$, showing that language abilities can scaffold mathematical discovery in neural models.

title: STORX: An Open-Source Object-Oriented Framework for Shape and Topology Optimization in MATLAB
summary: This paper presents STORX: Shape and Topology Optimization for Research and Experimentation, an open-source MATLAB-based educational framework for learning and teaching computational design optimization. STORX provides a platform for parametric and level-set shape optimization, as well as topology optimization methods including density, level-set, and topological sensitivity approaches such as evolutionary and Pareto-tracing methods. All modules follow a consistent object-oriented structure and integrate visualization, sensitivity analysis, and finite element routines, enabling users to explore the continuum between shape and topology optimization in a transparent and reproducible manner. The code is designed to complement graduate-level coursework and independent research by emphasizing modularity and extensibility through a clear separation of intent. Core software interfaces are defined via abstract base classes, enabling new objective functionals and design/manufacturing constraints to be implemented by adding derived classes without modifying the core code. The paper also describes the software architecture and demonstrates how the framework maps mathematical formulations directly to executable code through a series of illustrative problems.

title: Robust Direct Data-Driven Hamiltonian for Safe Set Computation under Measurement Noise and Disturbances
summary: Safe set computation is a fundamental challenge in safety-critical control systems, especially in direct data-driven settings where safety analysis is performed directly from noise-affected measurements, without explicit modeling. A recently proposed method, Data-Driven Hamiltonian (DDH), enables reachability analysis directly from measurements, without relying on prior knowledge of the underlying system dynamics. This paper extends the DDH framework to a robust setting that accounts for measurement noise, exogenous disturbances, and sampling-induced state-velocity estimation error. A Robust Data-Driven Hamiltonian (R-DDH) is derived from noisy measurements and shown to yield a certified lower bound on the exact Hamiltonian. This results in a provable under-approximation of the value function and an inner approximation of the associated safe set. The gap between the data-driven and exact Hamiltonians is quantified, and it is shown to converge to zero with more data in a noise-free setting with additive disturbances. The effectiveness of the approach is shown through two case studies: a constrained double integrator and an aircraft taxiing system with a nonlinear closed-loop controller operating under perceptual uncertainty.

title: VISTA: Scale-Aware Visual Navigation via Action History Conditioning
summary: Vision Navigation Foundation Models (VNMs) promise end-to-end learned navigation policies capable of zero-shot deployment across diverse embodiments and environments. To maintain generality, many vision-based navigation models predict normalized actions. However, this normalization introduces a critical deployment vulnerability: applying different scaling factors to the same normalized trajectory alters its physical geometry, which degrades navigation performance and increases collision risks. We address this vulnerability by conditioning the model on normalized action histories alongside image observations, providing explicit context on the relationship between the model's predictions and the robot's actual physical displacement. Furthermore, current VNMs often struggle in visually repetitive environments that lack distinct features. To resolve this issue, we integrate a DINOv3 encoder, whose richer representations enable our model to capture both spatial and geometric dimensions between observations. VISTA generalizes robustly to out-of-distribution environments, achieving 100% goal prediction accuracy in zero-shot, real-world deployment in Outdoor, Forest and Office settings, and an average of 95% checkpoints crossed, demonstrating consistent path following in unseen environments.

AI.title_translation: VISTA：通过动作历史条件化实现的视感知导航
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为VISTA的视觉导航模型，通过引入动作历史和改进的特征编码器来解决现有视觉导航模型在不同尺度部署和视觉重复环境中遇到的问题，并在多种场景下实现了高精度的导航。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉导航模型在不同尺度部署时存在性能下降和碰撞风险增加的问题，并且在视觉重复环境中表现不佳。
AI.method: 通过将归一化的动作历史与图像观察相结合来条件化模型，并集成DINOv3编码器以提取更丰富的表征。
AI.result: VISTA在零样本的真实世界部署中实现了100%的目标预测准确率，平均通过95%的检查点，在不同环境中表现出一致的路径跟随能力。
AI.conclusion: VISTA通过动作历史条件化和增强的特征表示，能够鲁棒地泛化到分布外环境，解决了现有视觉导航模型的关键部署问题。
AI.translation: 视觉导航基础模型（VNMs）有望实现端到端的导航策略学习，并能在各种具身和环境中进行零样本部署。为了保持通用性，许多基于视觉的导航模型会预测归一化的动作。然而，这种归一化引入了一个关键的部署漏洞：将相同的归一化轨迹应用于不同的尺度因子会改变其物理几何形状，从而降低导航性能并增加碰撞风险。我们通过将模型与图像观察一起基于归一化的动作历史进行条件化来解决这个漏洞，从而提供模型预测与其机器人的实际物理位移之间关系的明确上下文。此外，当前的VNMs在缺乏明显特征的视觉重复环境中常常遇到困难。为了解决这个问题，我们集成了DINOv3编码器，其更丰富的表征使我们的模型能够捕捉观察之间的空间和几何维度。VISTA能够鲁棒地泛化到分布外环境，在户外、森林和办公室场景中的零样本、真实世界部署中实现了100%的目标预测准确率，平均通过了95%的检查点，在看不见的环境中表现出一致的路径跟随能力。
AI.summary: VISTA是一种视觉导航模型，通过结合动作历史和DINOv3编码器来解决现有模型在尺度变化和视觉重复环境中的局限性。该模型在真实世界场景中取得了优异的零样本导航性能。
AI.keywords: 视觉导航, 动作历史, 尺度不变性, DINOv3, 零样本部署
AI.comments: 该研究解决了视觉导航领域中的一个重要问题，即在不同尺度部署下的性能下降问题。通过引入动作历史条件化，模型能够更好地理解和适应不同的物理尺度。此外，集成DINOv3编码器也提升了模型在复杂视觉环境中的表征能力。实验结果令人印象深刻，显示了该模型在实际应用中的潜力。然而，对于计算成本和在更广泛、更动态的环境中的泛化能力仍需进一步研究。

title: Pareto LoRA: Mitigating Modality Imbalance in Unified Multimodal Models via Pareto-Optimal Gradient Integration
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for integrating multimodal understanding and generation within a single autoregressive transformer. However, during multimodal instruction tuning, these models often exhibit pronounced modality imbalance: language gradients dominate optimization, thus leading to lower image generation quality, especially under parameter-efficient fine-tuning such as LoRA. In this work, we systematically analyze modality imbalance in LoRA-based fine-tuning of UMMs for interleaved text-image generation. We show that vision modality performance degrades substantially more than text modality performance when compared to unimodal counterparts, and that modality-specific gradients can differ by orders of magnitude across various tasks and layers. Motivated by this observation, we reformulate the multimodal instruction tuning as a bi-objective optimization problem and propose Pareto LoRA, a Pareto-optimal gradient integration strategy that balances the text and image objectives by modulating the gradient direction and strength. Experiments on the CoMM benchmark with Emu2 demonstrate that Pareto LoRA consistently improves multimodal generation balance, achieving up to 44.9% gains in perceptual image quality over vanilla LoRA while maintaining comparable text performance.

AI.title_translation: Pareto LoRA：通过帕累托最优梯度整合缓解统一多模态模型中的模态不平衡
AI.tldr: 统一多模态模型在LoRA微调时存在语言梯度主导的模态不平衡，导致图像生成质量差。本文提出Pareto LoRA，通过帕累托最优梯度整合策略平衡文本和图像目标，显著提升图像质量。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）在多模态指令微调中表现出显著的模态不平衡，即语言梯度主导优化过程，导致图像生成质量下降，尤其是在LoRA等参数高效微调方法下。
AI.method: 本文系统分析了LoRA微调下UMMs中交错文本-图像生成的模态不平衡问题，发现视觉模态性能下降远超文本模态，且模态特定梯度差异巨大。基于此观察，将多模态指令微调重新表述为双目标优化问题，并提出了Pareto LoRA，这是一种帕累托最优梯度整合策略，通过调节梯度方向和强度来平衡文本和图像目标。
AI.result: 在CoMM基准测试中，使用Emu2模型进行实验，Pareto LoRA持续改善多模态生成平衡，与香草LoRA相比，感知图像质量提升高达44.9%，同时保持了可比的文本性能。
AI.conclusion: Pareto LoRA通过帕累托最优梯度整合策略，成功缓解了统一多模态模型在LoRA微调中的模态不平衡问题，显著提升了图像生成质量，同时维持了良好的文本性能。
AI.translation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）最近作为一种有前景的范式出现，用于在单个自回归Transformer中整合多模态理解和生成。然而，在多模态指令微调期间，这些模型通常表现出显著的模态不平衡：语言梯度主导优化，从而导致图像生成质量下降，尤其是在LoRA等参数高效微调下。在这项工作中，我们系统地分析了在LoRA基础的UMMs微调中用于交错文本-图像生成的模态不平衡。我们表明，与单模态对应物相比，视觉模态性能下降明显多于文本模态性能，并且模态特定梯度在不同任务和层之间可能相差几个数量级。受此观察的启发，我们将多模态指令微调重新表述为双目标优化问题，并提出了Pareto LoRA，这是一种帕累托最优梯度整合策略，通过调节梯度方向和强度来平衡文本和图像目标。在CoMM基准测试中，使用Emu2进行的实验表明，Pareto LoRA始终改善多模态生成平衡，与香草LoRA相比，感知图像质量提升高达44.9%，同时保持了可比的文本性能。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了统一多模态模型在LoRA微调中存在的模态不平衡问题，即语言梯度主导导致图像生成质量下降。研究发现视觉模态性能下降显著，且模态梯度差异大。为此，作者将多模态指令微调重构为双目标优化问题，并提出Pareto LoRA，一种帕累托最优梯度整合策略，通过调节梯度来平衡文本和图像目标。实验证明，Pareto LoRA显著提升了图像生成质量（高达44.9%），同时保持了文本性能。
AI.keywords: 统一多模态模型, 模态不平衡, Pareto LoRA, 梯度整合, 参数高效微调
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过将模态不平衡问题重新定义为双目标优化，并引入帕累托最优梯度整合策略，为统一多模态模型的微调提供了一个新颖且有效的解决方案。特别是在LoRA等参数高效微调背景下，其对视觉模态性能的显著提升具有重要意义，有助于推动多模态模型在实际应用中的平衡发展。

title: Scalable K-clique Estimation with Differential Privacy
summary:
Counts of $k$-cliques are commonly used metrics in subgraph mining. Since graphs often have sensitive data, there also has been a lot of work on $k$-clique counts with differential privacy. However, these metrics have very high global sensitivity, and so more sophisticated techniques have been developed for counting $k$-cliques with privacy. Smooth sensitivity and ladder functions were developed for reducing the noise magnitude for private estimates of these metrics. However, these are computationally very inefficient to estimate. No polynomial time algorithms are known for smooth sensitivity of $k$-cliques for $k>3$, while the time complexity of ladder functions is lower bounded by the time for exact counts, which does not scale very well.
  In this paper, we develop a new highly scalable algorithm for estimating $k$-clique counts with differential privacy. Our algorithm adapts the ladder function to serve as a smooth upper bound on its local sensitivity, and utilizes the approximation sensitivity framework to calibrate noise with magnitude proportional to an approximation of the bound. This gives us a significant improvement in the running time. Experiments show that our method is several orders of magnitude faster than the ladder function based estimates of $k$-clique counts, while the accuracy is similar. Our algorithm is the first to scale to graphs with millions of edges, and for larger $k$, for which the ladder function algorithm doesn't complete.

AI.title_translation: 可扩展的差分隐私k-团估计算法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种可扩展的差分隐私k-团估计算法，通过改进平滑敏感度技术，在保证隐私性的同时显著提高了计算效率和可扩展性，能够处理具有数百万条边的图。
AI.motivation: 现有的差分隐私k-团计数方法计算效率低下，不适用于大规模图数据。
AI.method: 提出了一种新算法，该算法将梯子函数作为局部敏感度的平滑上界，并利用近似敏感度框架来校准噪声，使其幅度与边界的近似值成正比。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法比基于梯子函数的估计方法快几个数量级，精度相似，并且是第一个能够扩展到具有数百万条边的图以及处理更大k值的算法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种可扩展的差分隐私k-团估计算法，解决了现有方法的计算效率和可扩展性问题，为大规模图数据的隐私保护分析提供了新的解决方案。
AI.translation: k-团计数是子图挖掘中常用的度量。由于图通常包含敏感数据，因此在差分隐私下进行k-团计数方面已经进行了大量工作。然而，这些度量具有很高的全局敏感度，因此已经开发出更复杂的技术来在隐私保护下计数k-团。为了减小这些度量隐私估计的噪声幅度，人们开发了平滑敏感度和梯子函数。然而，这些方法的计算效率非常低。对于k>3的k-团，尚不知道平滑敏感度的多项式时间算法，而梯子函数的时间复杂度下界为精确计数所需的时间，这并不太具有可扩展性。在本论文中，我们开发了一种新的、高度可扩展的算法，用于在差分隐私下估计k-团计数。我们的算法将梯子函数改编为局部敏感度的平滑上界，并利用近似敏感度框架将噪声幅度校准为与边界的近似值成正比。这使我们的运行时间有了显著的提高。实验表明，我们的方法比基于梯子函数的k-团计数估计方法快几个数量级，而精度相似。我们的算法首次能够扩展到具有数百万条边的图，以及处理梯子函数算法无法完成的更大k值。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖且高度可扩展的差分隐私k-团估计算法。该算法通过改进梯子函数以作为局部敏感度的平滑上界，并结合近似敏感度框架来校准噪声，从而在保证差分隐私的同时，显著提高了计算效率。实验结果表明，该算法在处理具有数百万条边的超大规模图时，性能远超现有方法，且精度相当，是首个能够有效处理此类问题的算法。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私, k-团计数, 可扩展性, 梯子函数, 近似敏感度
AI.comments: 该研究在差分隐私k-团计数领域取得了重要进展，通过引入一种新颖的算法，有效解决了现有方法计算效率低和可扩展性差的问题。该算法在理论和实践上都具有重要意义，尤其是在处理大规模、高维度图数据时，为隐私保护下的图分析提供了更优的解决方案。然而，算法的具体实现细节和在不同类型图上的泛化能力仍需进一步探索。

title: Reasoning Text-to-Video Retrieval for Operating Room Clips via Action-Driven Digital Twins
summary: Text-to-video retrieval in operating rooms (OR) is an enabling technology for OR safety, as it allows stakeholders to retrieve and inspect recordings of specific events. However, because the most safety-critical events may not follow the common structure, to unlock its full potential text-to-video retrieval must be able to handle implicit queries that require reasoning to identify the right video (e.g., the step right before clipping). However, existing methods rely on global embeddings that cannot reason over such queries. We propose OR3, a text-to-video retrieval method that converts clips into action-driven digital twins (ActDTs), grouping concurrent subject-action-object triplets under non-overlapping temporal intervals. Moreover, rather than cross-modal matching through paired encoders, OR3 performs imagination-based retrieval where an LLM generates hypothetical ActDTs from queries. This enables intra-modal matching via a single encoder trained with ActDT-tailored hard negatives. Finally, evidence-grounded refinement revises imagined ActDTs based on discrepancies with top candidates to capture procedure-specific patterns. We construct a benchmark from MM-OR with 276 implicit queries across four reasoning categories over 386 clips from robotic knee procedures. OR3 achieves 57.6 R@1 and 77.3 R@5, outperforming the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate that OR3 enables fine-grained discrimination between visually similar OR video clips through temporal action reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 手术室片段的文本到视频检索推理，通过动作驱动的数字孪生
AI.tldr: 现有的文本到视频检索方法无法处理需要推理才能识别正确视频的隐式查询。我们提出了 OR3，一种将片段转换为动作驱动的数字孪生（ActDT）的方法，通过 LLM 生成假设的 ActDT 并进行基于证据的细化，从而在 MM-OR 基准上实现了 57.6 R@1 和 77.3 R@5 的性能，优于最强的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到视频检索方法依赖于全局嵌入，无法处理需要推理才能识别正确视频的隐式查询，而这类查询对于识别手术室中的安全关键事件至关重要。
AI.method: OR3 将手术室视频片段转换为动作驱动的数字孪生（ActDT），将并发的主体-动作-对象三元组分组到非重叠的时间间隔下。它不依赖于跨模态匹配，而是通过 LLM 生成假设的 ActDT 来进行基于想象的检索，并利用单编码器进行类内匹配。最后，通过基于证据的细化来修正假设的 ActDT。
AI.result: OR3 在 MM-OR 基准上实现了 57.6 R@1 和 77.3 R@5 的性能，优于最强的基线，证明了其能够通过时间动作推理实现细粒度区分视觉上相似的手术室视频片段。
AI.conclusion: OR3 通过动作驱动的数字孪生和基于想象的检索，能够实现需要推理的隐式文本到视频检索，并在手术室视频检索任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 手术室中的文本到视频检索是一项赋能 OR 安全的关键技术，因为它允许相关人员检索和检查特定事件的录像。然而，由于最安全关键的事件可能不遵循通用结构，因此要充分发挥其潜力，文本到视频检索必须能够处理需要推理才能识别正确视频的隐式查询（例如，剪辑前的步骤）。然而，现有方法依赖于无法对这类查询进行推理的全局嵌入。我们提出了 OR3，一种将剪辑转换为动作驱动的数字孪生（ActDT）的文本到视频检索方法，将并发的主体-动作-对象三元组分组到非重叠的时间间隔下。此外，OR3 不通过配对编码器进行跨模态匹配，而是进行基于想象的检索，其中 LLM 从查询生成假设的 ActDT。这使得类内匹配可以通过一个使用 ActDT 定制硬负样本进行训练的单一编码器来实现。最后，基于证据的细化根据与顶级候选者的差异来修改假设的 ActDT，以捕捉过程特定的模式。我们使用 MM-OR 构建了一个基准，其中包含 276 个隐式查询，涵盖了机器人膝关节手术 386 个片段的四个推理类别。OR3 实现了 57.6 R@1 和 77.3 R@5 的性能，优于最强的基线。这些结果表明，OR3 通过时间动作推理能够实现对视觉上相似的手术室视频片段进行细粒度区分。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了 OR3，一种用于手术室视频的文本到视频检索方法。与现有依赖全局嵌入的方法不同，OR3 将视频转换为动作驱动的数字孪生（ActDT），并利用大型语言模型（LLM）生成假设的 ActDT 来处理需要推理的隐式查询。通过基于证据的细化和类内匹配，OR3 能够实现对细微差别的手术室视频片段的精确检索。在 MM-OR 基准上的实验结果表明，OR3 在 R@1 和 R@5 指标上均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 文本到视频检索, 手术室视频, 动作驱动数字孪生, 隐式查询, 推理
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的文本到视频检索方法 OR3，通过引入动作驱动的数字孪生（ActDT）和基于想象的检索机制，有效解决了手术室视频检索中处理隐式查询的难题。该方法通过 LLM 生成假设的 ActDT 并进行基于证据的细化，实现了细粒度的视频区分能力。然而，ActDT 的构建和 LLM 的推理效率可能是在大规模应用中需要考虑的因素。

title: Examining the Limits of Word2Vec with Toki Pona
comments: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the Society for Computation in Linguistics (SCiL) 2026
summary: Word2Vec's effectiveness at generating semantic embeddings has been widely validated, yet it has been tested almost exclusively on languages with large vocabulary inventories. This study examines whether Word2Vec can successfully capture semantic relationships within an extremely reduced vocabulary using data from Toki Pona, a constructed language with approximately 130 words. We sourced 1.4 million sentences (7.95 million tokens) from the Toki Pona community for training. Approximately 23% of sentences in the corpus contain non-Toki Pona tokens such as named entities, loanwords, and neologisms. To investigate whether this linguistic noise enhances or hinders performance -- a topic rarely addressed in word embedding literature -- we trained two distinct models: one retaining these incidental tokens and another filtering them out completely. Evaluation was conducted using quantitative methods measuring word proximity to semantic category centroids, automated silhouette scores via agglomerative clustering, and qualitative analysis utilizing representational similarity matrices compared against English. The results indicate that while sparse, non-core tokens do not affect the relative structure of the learned embeddings, they actually draw similar words closer together in the vector space. Importantly, Word2Vec's effectiveness depends more on distributional patterns than lexicon size even at this extreme lower bound.
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the Society for Computation in Linguistics (SCiL) 2026

AI.title_translation: 使用Toki Pona检验Word2Vec的局限性
AI.tldr: 研究发现，即使在极小词汇量的语言（如Toki Pona）中，Word2Vec也能捕捉语义关系，且稀疏的非核心词汇实际上有助于将相似词汇拉近。其有效性更多取决于分布模式而非词汇量。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多在词汇量大的语言中验证Word2Vec的有效性，本研究旨在探讨Word2Vec是否能在词汇量极小的语言（如仅约130个词的Toki Pona）中成功捕捉语义关系，并考察语言噪声（非Toki Pona词汇）对模型性能的影响。
AI.method:
1. 收集了来自Toki Pona社区的140万个句子（795万个词元）作为训练数据。
2. 训练了两个Word2Vec模型：一个保留了语料库中约23%的非Toki Pona词元（如专有名词、外来词和新词），另一个则完全过滤掉这些词元。
3. 通过以下方法进行评估：
    * 定量方法：测量词语与语义类别中心点的接近度。
    * 自动化方法：通过凝聚聚类计算轮廓系数。
    * 定性分析：利用表示相似性矩阵与英语进行比较。
AI.result:
1. 稀疏的非核心词元不影响学习到的嵌入的相对结构。
2. 这些非核心词元实际上能使向量空间中相似的词语更紧密。
3. Word2Vec的有效性更多地取决于词语的分布模式，而非词汇表的大小，即使在词汇量极低的极端情况下也是如此。
AI.conclusion: 即使在词汇量极小的语言中，Word2Vec也能有效地捕捉语义关系，且语料中存在的非核心词元（语言噪声）不仅不会阻碍性能，反而能促进相似词语在向量空间中靠近，这表明Word2Vec的性能主要依赖于词语的分布模式。
AI.translation: Word2Vec在生成语义嵌入方面的有效性已得到广泛验证，但其测试几乎完全局限于词汇量大的语言。本研究使用来自Toki Pona（一种拥有约130个词的人造语言）的数据，检验Word2Vec是否能在词汇量极度缩减的情况下成功捕捉语义关系。我们从Toki Pona社区获取了140万个句子（795万个词元）用于训练。语料库中约23%的句子包含非Toki Pona词元，如专有名词、外来词和新词。为了探究这种语言噪声是增强还是阻碍了性能——这是词嵌入文献中鲜有探讨的话题——我们训练了两个不同的模型：一个保留了这些偶然出现的词元，另一个则完全过滤掉了它们。评估通过测量词语与语义类别中心点的接近度、通过凝聚聚类获得的自动轮廓系数等定量方法，以及利用与英语进行比较的表示相似性矩阵进行定性分析。结果表明，虽然稀疏，非核心词元不影响学习到的嵌入的相对结构，但它们实际上能使向量空间中相似的词语更紧密。重要的是，即使在词汇量极低的极端情况下，Word2Vec的有效性更多地取决于分布模式而非词汇表的大小。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了Word2Vec在词汇量极小的语言（Toki Pona，约130词）中的有效性，该语言语料库中包含约23%的非核心词汇。通过训练并比较保留或过滤这些噪声词汇的两个模型，并使用定量（词语接近度、轮廓系数）和定性（相似性矩阵）方法进行评估。结果显示，非核心词汇不影响嵌入的相对结构，反而能使相似词语在向量空间中更接近。研究强调，Word2Vec的有效性主要依赖于词语的分布模式而非词汇量大小，即使在极端低词汇量环境下也成立。
AI.keywords: Word2Vec, Toki Pona, 词嵌入, 语义关系, 语言噪声
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过在一个极端受限的词汇环境中（Toki Pona）测试Word2Vec，对现有关于词嵌入的认知提出了有趣的挑战。其创新之处在于不仅验证了Word2Vec在小词汇量下的可行性，还深入探讨了语料中“语言噪声”（非核心词汇）对模型性能的影响，发现这些噪声词汇实际上可能是有益的，这为未来的词嵌入研究和模型应用提供了新的视角。这项工作对于理解词嵌入模型在资源稀缺语言中的表现具有重要意义。

title: Construction of codes over a commutative non-unital ring from simplicial complexes and their applications
summary: In this article, we investigate the construction of linear codes over a finite ring $\mathcal{S}$, where $\mathcal{S}$ is taken to be an extension of a commutative non-unital ring $I$ of order $p^2$. Our approach is based on the defining set method. The defining sets considered in this work are derived from general simplicial complexes that may contain multiple maximal elements. We determine the parameters of these codes over $\mathcal{S}$ and study their Gray images. We also study the corresponding subfield-like codes. We show that these Gray image codes and subfield-like codes produce several families of divisible codes. Furthermore, we establish sufficient conditions under which these codes are minimal, optimal, and self-orthogonal. As applications of our results, we obtain several families of projective few-weight codes, and locally recoverable codes with small locality. We also study the minimal access structures of secret-sharing schemes associated with the duals of these minimal codes. Moreover, we construct several families of strongly regular graphs from projective two-weight codes and determine their parameters explicitly.

AI.title_translation: 基于单纯复形及其应用的交换非幺环上的码的构造
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在有限环S上构建线性码的方法，其中S是阶为p^2的交换非幺环I的扩展。通过定义集方法，并利用单纯复形，作者构建了多族可分码、投影少权码、局部可恢复码和强正则图。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在研究在特定的有限环（交换非幺环的扩展）上构建线性码的方法，并探索这些码的性质及其在编码理论和密码学中的应用。
AI.method: 研究方法基于定义集方法，其中定义集来源于可能包含多个极大元素的广义单纯复形。文章确定了码的参数，研究了它们的格雷像和子域类码。此外，还建立了码为最小、最优和自正交的充分条件。
AI.result: 构建的格雷像码和子域类码产生了多族可分码。在特定条件下，这些码是最小的、最优的和自正交的。作为应用，获得了多族投影少权码和具有小局部性的局部可恢复码。研究了与这些最小码的对偶相关的秘密共享方案的最小访问结构。从投影二权码构造了多族强正则图并明确确定了它们的参数。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地在交换非幺环的扩展上构建了线性码，并展示了这些码具有多种优良的编码性质，包括可分性、最小性、最优性、自正交性，并能应用于构造投影少权码、局部可恢复码和强正则图。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了在有限环 $\mathcal{S}$ 上线性码的构造，其中 $\mathcal{S}$ 被视为阶为 $p^2$ 的交换非幺环 $I$ 的扩展。我们的方法基于定义集方法。本文中考虑的定义集来源于可能包含多个极大元素的广义单纯复形。我们确定了这些在 $\mathcal{S}$ 上的码的参数，并研究了它们的格雷像。我们还研究了相应的子域类码。我们表明这些格雷像码和子域类码产生了多族可分码。此外，我们建立了这些码是最小的、最优的和自正交的充分条件。作为我们结果的应用，我们获得了多族投影少权码和具有小局部性的局部可恢复码。我们还研究了与这些最小码的对偶相关的秘密共享方案的最小访问结构。此外，我们从投影二权码构造了多族强正则图并明确确定了它们的参数。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在阶为p^2的交换非幺环I的扩展S上构建线性码。通过基于广义单纯复形的定义集方法，确定了这些码的参数，并分析了它们的格雷像和子域类码。研究表明，这些码产生了多族可分码，并建立了它们是最小、最优和自正交的充分条件。作为应用，文章获得了多族投影少权码和局部可恢复码，并从投影二权码构造了多族强正则图，同时还研究了秘密共享方案的最小访问结构。
AI.keywords: 单纯复形, 线性码, 交换非幺环, 可分码, 秘密共享方案
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将单纯复形引入到交换非幺环上的码的构造中，这为构建具有特定性质的码提供了一种新颖的方法。其重要性体现在构建了多族具有良好编码性质的码，例如可分码、少权码和局部可恢复码，并且在秘密共享和强正则图构造方面也有应用。这种跨领域的研究方法，即结合代数结构（非幺环）、组合结构（单纯复形）和编码理论，具有显著的理论和实践意义。

title: Turning music identification into a neural forward pass
summary: Search, a foundational operation in computer science, maps a query to a matching item in a collection. It is typically implemented as a System-2 like, rule-based pipeline in which a key is computed, an index is probed, and candidates are verified. By contrast, human recognition resembles a System-1 like, associative model of identity recovery, in which even partial cues can trigger a recall without explicitly enumerating, ranking, or even accessing discrete candidates. Here, we show that music sound identification, a difficult search problem, can be performed in a single neural feed-forward pass by a generative transformer. Trained on an audio dataset, the model predicts the corresponding track identifier from a short audio excerpt. This approach surpasses state-of-the-art acoustic fingerprinting, with the largest gains for short audio segments (1 second), demonstrating the method is not only viable but advantageous. Moreover, it reduces external storage to 0.33% of the baseline footprint and improves inference latency by 2.3x (p95). Furthermore, the model can reject queries for unseen tracks, supporting open-set operation while reducing misattribution risk. Using music track identification as an example, this work reframes search, bringing it closer in spirit to human associative recognition and away from algorithmic database lookup.

AI.title_translation: 将音乐识别转化为神经前向传递
AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种通过生成式Transformer模型，将音乐识别这一困难的搜索问题转化为单次神经前向传递的方法，该方法超越了现有技术，尤其在短音频片段上表现优异，并显著减少了存储和推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 传统的搜索方法（如音乐识别）通常是基于规则的系统，需要计算键、探测索引和验证候选。然而，人类识别更类似于联想模型，即使是部分线索也能触发回忆。本文旨在将音乐识别这一困难的搜索问题，通过深度学习方法，使其更接近人类的联想识别模式，并克服现有声学指纹技术的局限性。
AI.method: 研究人员使用一个生成式Transformer模型，在音频数据集上进行训练。该模型能够从短音频片段中预测相应的曲目标识符，实现单次神经前向传递的音乐识别。
AI.result: 该方法超越了最先进的声学指纹技术，尤其在短音频段（1秒）上表现出最大的增益。它将外部存储减少到基线足迹的0.33%，并将推理延迟提高了2.3倍（p95）。此外，模型能够拒绝未见曲目的查询，支持开放集操作，同时降低了错误归因的风险。
AI.conclusion: 本工作通过将音乐识别作为示例，重新定义了搜索，使其在精神上更接近人类的联想识别，而非算法数据库查找。该方法在性能、存储和延迟方面均优于现有技术，并支持开放集操作。
AI.translation: 搜索是计算机科学中的一项基础操作，它将查询映射到集合中匹配的项。它通常被实现为类似System-2的、基于规则的管道，其中计算键，探测索引，并验证候选。相比之下，人类识别类似于类似System-1的、联想的身份恢复模型，其中即使是部分线索也能触发回忆，而无需明确枚举、排序甚至访问离散的候选。在这里，我们展示了音乐声音识别这一困难的搜索问题，可以通过生成式Transformer在单次神经前向传递中完成。该模型在音频数据集上进行训练，从短音频片段中预测相应的曲目标识符。这种方法超越了最先进的声学指纹技术，对于短音频片段（1秒）的增益最大，证明该方法不仅可行而且具有优势。此外，它将外部存储减少到基线足迹的0.33%，并将推理延迟提高了2.3倍（p95）。此外，该模型可以拒绝针对未见曲目的查询，支持开放集操作，同时降低了错误归因的风险。本文以音乐曲目识别为例，重新定义了搜索，使其在精神上更接近人类联想识别，并远离算法数据库查找。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用生成式Transformer模型实现音乐识别的新方法，通过单次神经前向传递，将传统的搜索问题转化为类似于人类联想识别的过程。该模型在音频数据集上训练，能够从短音频片段中准确识别曲目，并在性能上超越了现有声学指纹技术，尤其在短音频识别方面表现突出。此外，该方法显著减少了存储空间，提高了推理速度，并能有效处理未见曲目的识别请求，降低了误识别风险。
AI.keywords: 音乐识别, 神经前向传递, Transformer, 声学指纹, 联想识别
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将音乐识别这一复杂的搜索问题，通过生成式Transformer模型，转化为一个高效的单次神经前向传递过程，这与传统基于规则的搜索方法形成鲜明对比，更接近人类的联想识别机制。该方法在性能、存储效率和推理速度方面均取得了显著提升，特别是在处理短音频片段时的优越性，以及对开放集操作的支持，都体现了其重要的实际应用价值和技术突破。

title: A program to find families of graphs in Free$\{C_4,4K_1\}$ with bounded clique width
comments: The source of the programm will be uploaded later
summary:
In this paper we study the class of graphs without cycles of size 4 and independent sets of size 4 as induced subgraphs: $\mathop{Free}\{C_4, 4K_1\}$. This is one of the three minimal minimal open cases for the complexity of the colouring problem when restricted to classes defined by excluding induced subgraphs of order 4. We investigate the clique width of some subclasses of $\mathop{Free}\{C_4, 4K_1\}$.
  We introduce a new framework: the $(k,l,m)$-decomposition and prove that if all the graphs of a class $\cal G$ are $(k,l,m)$-decomposable, then graphs in $\cal G$ have bounded clique width. We give a few examples of such class, found with the help of a program we designed.
  We also show, for any graph $G \in \mathop{Free}\{C_4, 4K_1\}$ that is 3 cliques coverable, an infinite family in $\mathop{Free}\{C_4, 4K_1\}$ of supergraphs of $G$ which have unbounded clique width.

AI.title_translation: 一个在Free$\{C_4,4K_1\}$中寻找具有有界团宽的图族的程序

AI.translation: 本文研究了不含大小为4的环和大小为4的独立集作为诱导子图的图类：$\mathop{Free}\{C_4, 4K_1\}$。这是在限制为排除阶数为4的诱导子图所定义的图类时，着色问题复杂性的三个最小开放案例之一。我们研究了$\mathop{Free}\{C_4, 4K_1\}$中一些子类的团宽。我们引入了一个新框架：$(k,l,m)$-分解，并证明如果一个图类$\cal G$中的所有图都是$(k,l,m)$-可分解的，那么$\cal G$中的图具有有界团宽。我们给出了几个这样的图类示例，这些示例是借助我们设计的程序找到的。我们还表明，对于任何3-团可覆盖的图$G \in \mathop{Free}\{C_4, 4K_1\}$，存在一个在$\mathop{Free}\{C_4, 4K_1\}$中的$G$的超图的无限族，这些超图具有无界团宽。

AI.keywords: 团宽, Free$\{C_4, 4K_1\}$, 图分解, 着色问题, 诱导子图

title: Abstention-Aware Personalized Object Rearrangement via Uncertainty-Guided LLM Assistance
comments: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 35th International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
summary: Robotic assistance in household environments requires not only predicting where objects should be placed, but also reasoning about when objects should not be placed at all. Existing approaches to personalized object rearrangement primarily focus on placement decisions under the assumption of clean observations and complete actionability, limiting their applicability in realistic, cluttered, and partially erroneous settings. In this paper, we introduce APOLLO, a hybrid framework for abstention-aware personalized object rearrangement that combines a lightweight, personalized embedding model (PEM) with selective large language model (LLM) assistance. PEM is trained for each user-environment pair using a small number of demonstrations, operates entirely on CPU, and produces uncertainty estimates, which are used to selectively invoke LLM-based reasoning only for ambiguous decisions, balancing efficiency, privacy, and reasoning capability. To evaluate this formulation beyond existing benchmarks, we introduce APOR, a synthetic, LLM-generated dataset that captures room-level, multi-furniture environments, diverse organizational profiles, explicit abstention behavior, and noisy partial scene context. Extensive experiments on both PARSEC and APOR provide initial evidence that APOLLO improves over prior LLM-based baselines in controlled benchmark settings while substantially reducing LLM usage. Code is available at https://github.com/PaInt-Lab/APOLLO.

AI.title_translation: 通过不确定性引导的LLM辅助实现避让感知的个性化物体重新排列
AI.tldr: APOLLO是一种混合框架，用于避让感知的个性化物体重新排列，结合了轻量级个性化嵌入模型和选择性LLM辅助。它在效率、隐私和推理能力之间取得平衡，并在实验中表现优于现有LLM基线并显著减少LLM使用。
AI.motivation: 现有的个性化物体重新排列方法主要关注放置决策，并假设观察清晰和行动完全可行，这限制了它们在现实、杂乱和部分错误环境中的适用性。此外，它们未能推理何时不应放置物体。
AI.method: 本文引入了APOLLO，一个用于避让感知个性化物体重新排列的混合框架。它结合了一个轻量级的个性化嵌入模型（PEM）和选择性的大型语言模型（LLM）辅助。PEM针对每个用户-环境对进行训练，使用少量演示，并在CPU上运行，生成不确定性估计。这些不确定性估计用于仅在模糊决策时选择性地调用基于LLM的推理。为了超越现有基准进行评估，本文还引入了APOR，一个合成的、LLM生成的数据集，捕获了房间级别、多家具环境、多样化的组织配置文件、明确的避让行为和嘈杂的部分场景上下文。
AI.result: 在PARSEC和APOR上的广泛实验提供了初步证据，表明APOLLO在受控基准设置中优于之前的基于LLM的基线，同时大幅减少了LLM的使用。
AI.conclusion: APOLLO框架通过结合个性化嵌入模型和不确定性引导的LLM辅助，有效地解决了避让感知的个性化物体重新排列问题，在效率、隐私和推理能力之间取得了平衡，并在实际场景中表现出优越性并显著降低了LLM的依赖。
AI.translation: 机器人辅助在家庭环境中不仅需要预测物体应该放置在哪里，还需要推理何时根本不应该放置物体。现有的个性化物体重新排列方法主要关注在清晰观察和完全可操作性假设下的放置决策，这限制了它们在现实、杂乱和部分错误设置中的适用性。在本文中，我们引入了APOLLO，一个用于避让感知个性化物体重新排列的混合框架，它结合了一个轻量级的个性化嵌入模型（PEM）和选择性的大型语言模型（LLM）辅助。PEM针对每个用户-环境对使用少量演示进行训练，完全在CPU上运行，并产生不确定性估计，这些估计用于仅在模糊决策时选择性地调用基于LLM的推理，从而平衡效率、隐私和推理能力。为了超越现有基准评估这一公式，我们引入了APOR，一个合成的、LLM生成的数据集，它捕获了房间级别、多家具环境、多样化的组织配置文件、明确的避让行为和嘈杂的部分场景上下文。在PARSEC和APOR上进行的广泛实验提供了初步证据，表明APOLLO在受控基准设置中优于之前的基于LLM的基线，同时大幅减少了LLM的使用。代码可在https://github.com/PaInt-Lab/APOLLO获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了APOLLO，一个针对避让感知个性化物体重新排列的混合框架。它结合了轻量级的个性化嵌入模型（PEM）和选择性的大型语言模型（LLM）辅助。PEM根据不确定性评估决定何时调用LLM，以平衡效率、隐私和推理能力。为了评估，研究者还引入了APOR数据集。实验结果表明，APOLLO在性能上优于现有的LLM基线，并显著减少了LLM的使用。
AI.keywords: 个性化物体重新排列, 避让感知, LLM辅助, 不确定性引导, 机器人辅助
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种混合框架APOLLO，通过结合轻量级个性化模型和不确定性引导的选择性LLM辅助，解决了机器人避让感知个性化物体重新排列的挑战。这种方法有效地平衡了效率、隐私和推理能力，对于在现实世界中部署具有成本效益和隐私保护的机器人系统具有重要意义。引入APOR数据集也为该领域提供了新的评估工具。

title: SierpinskiCam: Camera-Controlled Video Retaking with Sierpinski Triangle Pattern Cues
summary: Generating novel renderings of a scene along user-defined camera trajectories from a single monocular video, dubbed video retaking, is a compelling but difficult problem in content creation and visual effects. Existing geometry-guided approaches reconstruct a 4D representation from the source video and render it along the target trajectory to condition video diffusion models. However, this guidance degrades as the target camera departs from the source trajectory, leaving newly revealed regions sparse or entirely missing. We propose SierpinskiCam, which addresses this limitation by augmenting geometry-based guidance with Sierpinski dome texture cues that contains rich trackable features even under large viewpoint changes. We further introduce a reference video conditioning mechanism that appends source-video tokens to the target-token sequence and separates the two streams with negative RoPE indices, enabling appearance grounding without architectural modification or per-video adaptation. Extensive experiments show that SierpinskiCam achieves significant gains in camera controllability, geometric consistency, and video quality across diverse and challenging retaking scenarios. Project page: https://hyelinnam.github.io/SierpinskiCam/.

AI.title_translation: SierpinskiCam：基于谢尔宾斯基三角形模式线索的相机控制视频重拍
AI.tldr: SierpinskiCam 通过引入分形纹理线索和高效的参考视频条件机制，解决了单目视频重拍中大视角偏移导致的生成质量下降问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的几何引导视频重拍方法在相机偏离原始轨迹时，由于新露出的区域信息稀疏或缺失，导致引导效果严重退化。
AI.method: 提出 SierpinskiCam，通过在场景中添加谢尔宾斯基穹顶纹理线索以增强在大视角变化下的特征追踪能力；同时引入参考视频条件机制，通过负 RoPE 索引将源视频标记与目标标记序列分离，实现无需额外训练的表征关联。
AI.result: 实验表明，SierpinskiCam 在多种复杂重拍场景下，在相机可控性、几何一致性和视频生成质量方面均取得了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: SierpinskiCam 通过结合分形纹理线索和高效的参考视频条件机制，显著提升了单目视频重拍任务中的视角可控性、几何一致性和视频质量。
AI.translation: 从单一单目视频沿用户定义的相机轨迹生成场景的新颖渲染（即视频重拍）是内容创作和视觉效果中的一个引人注目但困难的问题。现有的几何引导方法从源视频中重建 4D 表示，并沿目标轨迹渲染它以调节视频扩散模型。然而，当目标相机偏离源轨迹时，这种引导会退化，导致新露出的区域稀疏或完全缺失。我们提出了 SierpinskiCam，它通过用包含丰富可追踪特征（即使在大视角变化下）的谢尔宾斯基穹顶纹理线索增强基于几何的引导，解决了这一局限性。我们进一步引入了一种参考视频调节机制，该机制将源视频标记附加到目标标记序列，并用负 RoPE 索引分隔这两个流，从而在无需架构修改或每个视频调整的情况下实现外观基础（appearance grounding）。大量实验表明，SierpinskiCam 在各种具有挑战性的重拍场景中，在相机可控性、几何一致性和视频质量方面取得了显著的增益。
AI.summary: SierpinskiCam 是一种用于单目视频重拍的新方法，它通过引入谢尔宾斯基三角形纹理线索来辅助几何引导，解决大视角变化下的信息缺失问题，并利用一种创新的参考视频条件机制，在无需对模型进行特定视频调整的情况下，实现了高质量、高一致性的视频生成。
AI.keywords: 视频重拍, 谢尔宾斯基三角形, 视频扩散模型, 视角可控性, 几何一致性
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地利用分形几何（谢尔宾斯基三角形）作为视觉线索来增强几何引导，解决了视频重拍中大视角变化下的信息缺失问题。其创新点在于引入了无需架构修改的参考视频条件机制，提升了生成的一致性与可控性。

title: Quantifying Consistency in LLM Logical Reasoning via Structural Uncertainty
comments: Published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. Accepted as best paper
summary: Large language models can arrive at the same answer through reasoning paths that are unstable, contradictory, or difficult to rank consistently -- a failure mode especially prevalent in multi-step deductive reasoning. Existing methods assess reliability primarily through output dispersion -- measuring how much sampled answers differ -- but this discards a complementary signal: whether the model can consistently rank competing reasoning candidates. We propose structural uncertainty, a consistency-aware framework derived from the stability of self-preference-induced rankings over sampled reasoning solutions. Given a query, we generate multiple candidate solutions and ask the model to judge pairwise preferences among its own outputs. We aggregate self-preferences into ranking distributions via Bradley-Terry modeling with PageRank, and decompose the signal into two entropy-based components: across-trial ranking instability and within-trial candidate ambiguity. Across five LLMs and eight benchmarks, structural signals provide information complementary to answer dispersion: on logical and mathematical reasoning tasks, the combination improves identification of unreliable instances, while on factual retrieval the structural signal collapses toward uniformity, diagnosing a regime boundary where reasoning-level consistency evaluation is uninformative. The two components relate differently to accuracy: within-trial ambiguity correlates positively with correctness -- consistent with settings where multiple plausible solution paths remain competitive -- while across-trial instability correlates negatively, signaling unreliable reasoning. Structural uncertainty is best understood not as a universal confidence estimator, but as a regime-sensitive evaluator of logical reasoning consistency.
comment: Published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. Accepted as best paper

AI.title_translation: 通过结构化不确定性量化大语言模型逻辑推理的一致性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过评估大模型对自身推理路径的排序偏好来衡量逻辑推理一致性的新方法，能有效识别传统方法难以发现的推理失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的可靠性评估方法主要关注输出答案的分散度，忽略了模型在推理过程中对候选路径进行一致性排序的能力，导致在大模型多步推理失效模式的检测上存在局限。
AI.method: 提出了“结构化不确定性”框架：首先生成多个推理路径，通过模型自身的两两比较评估偏好，利用 Bradley-Terry 模型结合 PageRank 生成排序分布，并将其分解为“跨试验排序不稳定性”和“试验内候选模糊度”两个熵基组件。
AI.result: 在五个大模型和八个基准测试中，结构化信号与答案分散度形成互补；跨试验不稳定性与准确率负相关（代表推理不可靠），而试验内模糊度与准确率正相关（代表多解竞争的合理性）；在逻辑推理任务中能有效识别不可靠实例，但在事实检索中失效。
AI.conclusion: 结构化不确定性（Structural Uncertainty）是评估大模型逻辑推理一致性的有效工具，能够识别出基于答案分散度无法捕捉的推理失效模式，特别适用于区分逻辑推理与事实检索任务。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型可以通过不稳定、矛盾或难以一致排序的推理路径得出相同的答案——这种失效模式在多步演绎推理中尤为普遍。现有的方法主要通过输出分散度来评估可靠性（即测量采样答案之间的差异），但这丢弃了一个互补信号：模型能否一致地对竞争的推理候选路径进行排序。我们提出了结构化不确定性，这是一个源自自偏好诱导排序在采样推理解决方案中稳定性的的一致性感知框架。给定一个查询，我们生成多个候选解决方案，并要求模型判断其自身输出之间的两两偏好。我们通过 Bradley-Terry 模型结合 PageRank 将自偏好聚合为排序分布，并将该信号分解为两个基于熵的组件：跨试验排序不稳定性（across-trial ranking instability）和试验内候选模糊度（within-trial candidate ambiguity）。在五个大模型和八个基准测试中，结构化信号提供了与答案分散度互补的信息：在逻辑和数学推理任务中，两者的结合提高了对不可靠实例的识别能力；而在事实检索中，结构化信号趋于均匀，诊断出一个推理级一致性评估失效的边界。这两个组件与准确率的关系不同：试验内模糊度与正确性正相关——这与存在多个合理解决方案路径竞争的环境一致；而跨试验不稳定性与正确性负相关，标志着推理不可靠。结构化不确定性最好不要被理解为一种通用的置信度估计器，而应被视为一种针对逻辑推理一致性的区域敏感评估器。
AI.summary: 本文针对大模型逻辑推理中存在的推理路径不稳定和矛盾问题，提出了一种基于“结构化不确定性”的评估框架。通过分析模型对自身推理路径的排序偏好，将逻辑一致性量化为跨试验不稳定性与试验内模糊度两个指标。研究表明，该方法能有效补充现有的答案分散度评估，提升对不可靠逻辑推理的识别能力。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 逻辑推理, 结构化不确定性, 自偏好排序, 一致性评估
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的视角，即利用模型对自身生成内容的排序偏好来衡量逻辑推理的稳定性。相比仅关注最终答案的一致性，该方法更深入地挖掘了推理过程中的结构化信息，对理解大模型推理的可靠性边界具有重要意义。

title: Line Outage Impact Factor (LOIF): A New Sensitivity Factor for Enhanced Transmission Observability
summary: Transmission failures can lead to cascading failures and system blackout affecting millions of customers if not handled in time, and choosing the best locations to monitor the condition of the transmission system is crucial for power system reliability. In this paper, we propose a new sensitivity factor, the line outage impact factor (LOIF), which is especially useful for power system monitoring and can reveal the impacts of a transmission outage on the power flow of other lines more effectively than existing sensitivity factors, such as the line outage distribution factors (LODF). In this study, we apply the LOIF in transmission line outage detection in three test systems and compare it with LODF using a number of observed transmission line (OTL) selection methods based on these two sensitivity factors. Then we apply a machine learning algorithm to detect the outages of other lines by monitoring the selected OTLs, and the detection accuracy is evaluated using the F1-score. The results show that, in general, with the same number of OTLs, detection using the OTLs selected using LOIF achieved higher F1-scores. The pattern was especially consistent in large-scale systems, showing its potential in real-world applications.

AI.title_translation: 线路停运影响因子（LOIF）：一种用于增强输电可观测性的新型灵敏度因子
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的灵敏度因子——线路停运影响因子（LOIF），它比现有因子（如LODF）能更有效地揭示输电停运对其他线路潮流的影响。通过结合机器学习进行停运检测，LOIF在相同数量的观测线路下获得了更高的检测精度，尤其在大型系统中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 输电故障若不及时处理，可能导致连锁故障和系统停电，影响数百万用户。选择最佳位置监测输电系统状况对于确保电力系统可靠性至关重要。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新的灵敏度因子——线路停运影响因子（LOIF），用于电力系统监测。研究将其应用于三个测试系统中的输电线路停运检测，并与现有的线路停运分布因子（LODF）进行比较。通过基于这两种因子选择观测输电线路（OTL），再应用机器学习算法检测其他线路的停运，并使用F1分数评估检测精度。
AI.result: 结果表明，在相同数量的观测输电线路（OTL）下，使用LOIF选择的OTL进行停运检测通常能获得更高的F1分数。这种优势在大型系统中表现得尤为一致，显示了其在实际应用中的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的线路停运影响因子（LOIF）作为一种新型灵敏度因子，能够比现有因子更有效地揭示输电停运对其他线路潮流的影响。它在增强输电系统可观测性方面表现出优越性，特别是在大型系统中，通过结合机器学习算法可实现更高的停运检测精度，具有重要的实际应用潜力。
AI.translation: 输电故障如不及时处理，可能导致连锁故障和系统停电，影响数百万用户；选择最佳位置监测输电系统状况对于电力系统可靠性至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的灵敏度因子——线路停运影响因子（LOIF），它对电力系统监测特别有用，并且比现有的灵敏度因子（如线路停运分布因子（LODF））能更有效地揭示输电停运对其他线路潮流的影响。在本研究中，我们将LOIF应用于三个测试系统中的输电线路停运检测，并使用基于这两种灵敏度因子的多种观测输电线路（OTL）选择方法，将其与LODF进行比较。然后，我们应用机器学习算法通过监测选定的OTL来检测其他线路的停运，并使用F1分数评估检测精度。结果表明，在相同数量的OTL下，使用LOIF选择的OTL进行检测通常能获得更高的F1分数。这种模式在大型系统中尤其一致，显示了其在实际应用中的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为线路停运影响因子（LOIF）的新型灵敏度因子，旨在提高输电系统的可观测性。LOIF能比现有因子更有效地揭示输电故障对其他线路潮流的影响。研究通过在三个测试系统中，利用LOIF和LODF选择观测输电线路（OTL），并结合机器学习进行停运检测。结果显示，在相同OTL数量下，LOIF在停运检测中能实现更高的F1分数，尤其在大型系统中表现出良好的应用潜力。
AI.keywords: 线路停运影响因子, 灵敏度因子, 输电可观测性, 线路停运检测, 机器学习
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种创新的灵敏度因子LOIF，它在电力系统监测中展现出比传统方法更优的性能，尤其是在大型系统中检测输电线路停运方面。其结合机器学习的方法提高了检测准确性，具有重要的实际应用价值，有助于提升电力系统的可靠性和安全性。

title: Space-Efficient Lock-Free Linear-Probing Hash Table
summary:
Linear probing is one of the simplest and most space-efficient approaches to hash table design, and is widely used in sequential settings due to its compact memory layout. However, designing a concurrent linear-probing hash table with strong liveness guarantees has proved difficult, and only a handful of such algorithms have been proposed, all of which either restrict concurrency or rely on large per-entry metadata, thereby compromising space efficiency.
  We present a lock-free linear-probing hash table with wait-free lookups that retains the core advantages of sequential linear probing while handling contention gracefully. Our design uses only a small amount of metadata per table entry: a constant number of additional bits when using LL/SC, or a logarithmic number of bits when using CAS. The algorithm is linearizable and lock-free, supports insert, delete, and wait-free lookup operations, and is able to safely reclaim space used by deleted elements without rebuilding the table.
  We analyze the amortized step complexity of our hash table assuming no concurrent insertions of the same key, and show that each operation has expected amortized step complexity matching that of sequential linear probing, up to the point contention per key.

AI.title_translation: 空间高效的无锁线性探测哈希表
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型无锁线性探测哈希表，通过极少的元数据开销，在保持高空间效率的同时实现了高效的并发操作。
AI.motivation: 现有的并发线性探测哈希表要么限制并发性，要么依赖大量的元数据导致空间效率低下，无法兼顾空间紧凑性与强并发保证。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的无锁线性探测哈希表算法，利用极少的额外元数据（LL/SC下为常数位，CAS下为对数位），支持插入、删除和无等待查找操作，并实现了无需重建表的内存安全回收机制。
AI.result: 实验分析表明，该算法的操作具有与顺序线性探测相匹配的期望摊销复杂度，能够优雅地处理并发冲突，并实现了高效的无锁并发操作。
AI.conclusion: 该算法成功在无锁框架下实现了线性探测哈希表，在保持高效空间利用率的同时，实现了线性化、无锁插入/删除以及无等待查找，是并发数据结构领域的一项重要进展。
AI.translation: 线性探测是哈希表设计中最简单且空间效率最高的方法之一，由于其紧凑的内存布局，被广泛应用于顺序场景。然而，设计一个具有强活性保证的并发线性探测哈希表已被证明十分困难，目前仅有的少数几种算法要么限制了并发性，要么依赖于每个条目大量的元数据，从而牺牲了空间效率。我们提出了一种具有无等待查找功能的无锁线性探测哈希表，在处理并发冲突的同时，保留了顺序线性探测的核心优势。我们的设计在每个表条目中仅使用少量元数据：使用LL/SC时为常数位，使用CAS时为对数位。该算法是线性化的且无锁的，支持插入、删除和无等待查找操作，并且能够在不重建表的情况下安全地回收已删除元素所占用的空间。我们分析了该哈希表的摊销步长复杂度（假设没有对同一键的并发插入），并证明每个操作的期望摊销步长复杂度与顺序线性探测相匹配（直至键冲突点）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种空间高效的无锁线性探测哈希表，通过极简的元数据管理，在支持无锁插入/删除和无等待查找的同时，保留了线性探测原有的紧凑内存布局优势。
AI.keywords: 无锁, 线性探测, 哈希表, 空间效率, 并发控制
AI.comments: 该论文解决了并发哈希表中空间效率与性能之间的矛盾，通过创新的元数据管理方案实现了真正的无锁线性探测哈希表，在保持空间紧凑性的同时提供了强大的并发保证。

title: Approximation Preserving Coresets
summary:
Clustering in a big data setting is an intensively studied problem, with coresets emerging as one of the important paradigms in this line of work. Given a cost function $\text{cost}(P,S)$ mapping input points $P$ and a solution $S$ to an objective value, a coreset is a typically weighted sketch $Ω\subseteq P$ such that $\text{cost}(Ω,S)\approx \text{cost}(P,S)$. In practice, coreset sizes much smaller than those suggested by theoretical guarantees are often found to be sufficient.
  In this paper, we offer an explanation for this phenomenon. Smaller coreset sizes suffice if we only wish to preserve the costs of \emph{good} solutions, i.e., solutions with low cost. We define and devise \emph{approximation-preserving coresets}, which provide a weaker guarantee than strong coresets, which apply to all solutions, while providing stronger guarantees than weak coresets, which apply only to the optimum solution. We complement this result by showing that even a very small distortion in the approximation factor cannot admit coresets of this size.

AI.tldr: 本文通过提出“近似保持核集”，解释了为何在聚类任务中，仅关注高质量解可以大幅减小核集规模，并分析了其理论边界。
AI.motivation: 旨在解释在大数据聚类场景中，实际应用中的核集大小往往远小于现有理论所要求的规模这一现象。
AI.method: 定义并设计了“近似保持核集”，该方法通过仅对代价较低的“好解”提供近似保证，从而在保证效率的同时优化了核集的规模。此外，还通过理论分析证明了即使在近似因子上引入极小的畸变，也无法维持该规模的核集。
AI.result: 成功构建了近似保持核集，证明了其在处理高质量解时的有效性，并给出了关于近似因子畸变与核集大小之间权衡的理论下界。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，通过将核集的有效范围限制在“高质量解”上，可以显著减小核集规模，同时该研究也划定了此类方法在近似因子上的理论下界。
AI.translation: 在大数据背景下，聚类是一个被深入研究的问题，核集已成为该领域重要的范式之一。给定一个将输入点集 P 和解 S 映射为目标值的代价函数 cost(P,S)，核集通常是一个加权草图 Ω⊆P，使得 cost(Ω,S)≈cost(P,S)。在实践中，人们发现远小于理论保证规模的核集往往就已足够。在本文中，我们对此现象做出了解释。如果我们只想保留“好解”（即代价较低的解）的代价，那么更小的核集规模就足够了。我们定义并设计了“近似保持核集”，它提供了比强核集（适用于所有解）更弱的保证，同时比仅适用于最优解的弱核集提供了更强的保证。我们补充了这一结果，证明了即使在近似因子上存在非常小的畸变，也无法实现这种规模的核集。
AI.summary: 本文针对大数据聚类问题，提出了一种名为“近似保持核集”的新框架。该框架通过关注代价较低的“好解”而非所有可能的解，成功在强核集和弱核集之间取得了平衡，解释了实际应用中核集规模较小的原因，并论证了其在近似因子上的理论约束。
AI.keywords: 大数据聚类, 核集 (Coresets), 近似算法, 核心集大小, 代价函数
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“近似保持核集”（Approximation Preserving Coresets）这一新概念，在强核集（适用于所有解）和弱核集（仅适用于最优解）之间架起了一座桥梁，成功解释了为何实际应用中核集大小往往远小于理论保障值。其局限性在于对近似因子的微小扰动非常敏感，暗示了该方法在极端精度要求下的局限性。

title: Transformer-Based Warm-Starting for Feasible and Optimal Terminal Approach to Tumbling Objects with Space Manipulators
summary: Real-time trajectory generation for on-orbit robotic servicing is challenging due to the nonlinear coupling between spacecraft bus motion, manipulator dynamics, visibility cone, and trajectory-level safety constraints. This paper studies learning-based warm-starting for sequential convex programming (SCP) in the terminal approach of a space manipulator toward a tumbling target. The proposed framework decomposes the problem into a system center-of-mass translational planning stage and a coupled attitude--manipulator torque-allocation stage, and applies a causal transformer warm-start to the latter, which constitutes the dominant computational bottleneck. Linear and flow matching action decoders are compared under different action-chunking and training dataset sizes, and the resulting warm-starts are evaluated under both cost-optimal and feasibility projection using SCP. Across 300 held-out scenarios, the learned warm-start reduces the second-stage SCP iteration count by up to 28% and the runtime by 23% while preserving the final control-cost distribution. When the learned warm-starts are used for nonconvex feasibility projection, they nearly halve the runtime relative to cost-optimal SCP, while avoiding the catastrophic high-cost tail behavior observed when initialized heuristically. These results indicate that sequence-model warm-starts can improve both the computational efficiency and trajectory robustness of optimization-based terminal guidance for space manipulation.

AI.title_translation: 基于Transformer的暖启动方法，用于空间机械臂对翻滚物体的可行且最优末端接近
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer的暖启动方法，用于解决空间机械臂在接近翻滚目标时，在顺序凸规划（SCP）中的计算瓶颈，显著提高了计算效率和轨迹鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 实时在轨机器人服务轨迹生成面临挑战，原因在于航天器总线运动、机械臂动力学、可见锥和轨迹级安全约束之间的非线性耦合。
AI.method: 该框架将问题分解为系统质心平移规划阶段和姿态-机械臂扭矩分配耦合阶段。对后者（计算瓶颈）应用因果Transformer暖启动。比较了不同动作分块和训练数据集大小下的线性和流匹配动作解码器，并使用SCP评估了成本最优和可行性投影下的暖启动效果。
AI.result: 在300个保留场景中，学习到的暖启动将第二阶段SCP迭代次数减少了28%，运行时减少了23%，同时保持了最终控制成本分布。当用于非凸可行性投影时，运行时几乎减半，并避免了启发式初始化时观察到的灾难性高成本尾部行为。
AI.conclusion: 序列模型暖启动可以提高空间机械臂基于优化的末端引导的计算效率和轨迹鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 实时在轨机器人服务轨迹生成具有挑战性，原因在于航天器总线运动、机械臂动力学、可见锥和轨迹级安全约束之间的非线性耦合。本文研究了在空间机械臂接近翻滚目标时，顺序凸规划（SCP）中基于学习的暖启动方法。所提出的框架将问题分解为系统质心平移规划阶段和姿态-机械臂扭矩分配耦合阶段，并对后者（即主要的计算瓶颈）应用因果Transformer暖启动。在不同的动作分块和训练数据集大小下，比较了线性和流匹配动作解码器，并使用SCP在成本最优和可行性投影下评估了所得的暖启动效果。在300个保留场景中，学习到的暖启动将第二阶段SCP迭代次数减少了28%，运行时减少了23%，同时保持了最终控制成本分布。当学习到的暖启动用于非凸可行性投影时，运行时相对于成本最优SCP几乎减半，同时避免了启发式初始化时观察到的灾难性高成本尾部行为。这些结果表明，序列模型暖启动可以提高空间机械臂基于优化的末端引导的计算效率和轨迹鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文针对空间机械臂在轨服务中接近翻滚目标的实时轨迹生成难题，提出了一种基于Transformer的暖启动方法，以加速顺序凸规划（SCP）。该方法将问题分解并对计算瓶颈——姿态-机械臂扭矩分配阶段应用因果Transformer暖启动。实验结果表明，该方法显著减少了SCP的迭代次数和运行时间，尤其在可行性投影中能将运行时间减半，并有效避免了高成本尾部问题，从而提高了计算效率和轨迹鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: Transformer, 暖启动, 空间机械臂, 顺序凸规划, 轨迹规划
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将Transformer模型引入到空间机械臂轨迹规划的暖启动过程中，有效解决了SCP在复杂非线性问题中的计算效率瓶颈。通过将问题分解并针对性地应用学习方法，不仅提高了优化速度，还增强了轨迹的鲁棒性，对于未来在轨服务任务的实际应用具有重要意义。

title: ProCUA-SFT Technical Report
summary: Training computer-use agents (CUAs) -- models that interact with graphical desktops through screenshots and keyboard/mouse actions -- requires large-scale, diverse trajectory data collected in full desktop environments. The largest public resource, AgentNet (22.5K human trajectories), leads to negative transfer when used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT): continuing training UI-TARS 7B on AgentNet causes OSWorld success rate to fall from 26.3% to 8-10%. We present ProCUA-SFT, a dataset of 3.1M step-level SFT samples distilled from 93K synthetic trajectories across 2,484 application combinations. The dataset is produced by a fully automated pipeline that (i) synthesizes grounded tasks on live desktops seeded with real-world content -- 912 spreadsheets from SpreadsheetBench, approximately 10K permissively-licensed presentations from Zenodo10K, and multi-application OSWorld configs -- and (ii) verifies each task's feasibility through binary precondition checking before rollout. A single VLM (Kimi-K2.5) serves as goal generator, precondition judge, and trajectory executor, eliminating planner-actor capability gaps. Each trajectory is expanded into step-prefix samples that exactly reproduce the context layout seen at inference time. Fine-tuning UI-TARS 7B on ProCUA-SFT for one epoch yields 45.0% on OSWorld -- an 18.7 percentage-point improvement over the base model and over 35% above AgentNet-trained counterparts. A subset of ProCUA was incorporated into the training data for the Nemotron 3 Nano Omni model, contributing to its computer-use capabilities.

AI.tldr: ProCUA-SFT是一个大规模合成数据集，用于训练计算机使用代理，解决了现有数据集导致的负迁移问题，显著提升了UI-TARS 7B在OSWorld上的性能。
AI.motivation: 训练计算机使用代理（CUA）需要大规模、多样化的轨迹数据，但现有最大的公开资源AgentNet在用于监督微调（SFT）时会导致负迁移，使OSWorld成功率大幅下降。
AI.method: 提出了ProCUA-SFT数据集，包含3.1M步级SFT样本，这些样本从93K合成轨迹中蒸馏而来，涵盖2,484种应用程序组合。数据集通过一个全自动化流程生成，该流程在包含真实世界内容的实时桌面上合成任务，并通过二元前置条件检查验证任务可行性。一个单一的VLM（Kimi-K2.5）充当目标生成器、前置条件判断器和轨迹执行器，消除了规划器-执行器能力差距。每个轨迹被扩展为步前缀样本，以精确重现推理时的上下文布局。
AI.result: 使用ProCUA-SFT对UI-TARS 7B进行一个周期的微调，在OSWorld上的成功率达到45.0%，比基础模型提高了18.7个百分点，比使用AgentNet训练的模型高出35%以上。ProCUA的一个子集也被纳入Nemotron 3 Nano Omni模型的训练数据中，提升了其计算机使用能力。
AI.conclusion: ProCUA-SFT数据集及其自动化生成流程有效解决了计算机使用代理训练中数据质量和负迁移问题，显著提升了模型性能，并为其他大型模型提供了有价值的训练数据。
AI.translation: 训练计算机使用代理（CUA）——通过屏幕截图和键盘/鼠标操作与图形桌面交互的模型——需要在大规模、多样化的全桌面环境中收集轨迹数据。最大的公共资源AgentNet（22.5K人类轨迹）在用于监督微调（SFT）时会导致负迁移：继续训练UI-TARS 7B在AgentNet上会导致OSWorld成功率从26.3%下降到8-10%。我们提出了ProCUA-SFT，一个包含3.1M步级SFT样本的数据集，这些样本从2,484种应用程序组合的93K合成轨迹中蒸馏而来。该数据集由一个完全自动化的管道生成，该管道（i）在包含真实世界内容的实时桌面上合成基础任务——来自SpreadsheetBench的912个电子表格，来自Zenodo10K的约10K个允许许可的演示文稿，以及多应用程序OSWorld配置——并且（ii）在推出之前通过二元前置条件检查验证每个任务的可行性。一个单一的VLM（Kimi-K2.5）充当目标生成器、前置条件判断器和轨迹执行器，消除了规划器-执行器能力差距。每个轨迹被扩展为步前缀样本，以精确重现推理时看到的上下文布局。对UI-TARS 7B使用ProCUA-SFT进行一个周期的微调，在OSWorld上的成功率达到45.0%——比基础模型提高了18.7个百分点，比使用AgentNet训练的模型高出35%以上。ProCUA的一个子集被纳入Nemotron 3 Nano Omni模型的训练数据中，有助于其计算机使用能力。
AI.summary: 本技术报告介绍了ProCUA-SFT，一个大规模的合成数据集，旨在解决计算机使用代理（CUA）训练中现有数据集（如AgentNet）导致的负迁移问题。ProCUA-SFT包含3.1M步级SFT样本，由一个全自动管道生成，该管道在实时桌面环境中合成任务并验证其可行性，并利用单个VLM（Kimi-K2.5）作为多功能执行器。通过使用ProCUA-SFT对UI-TARS 7B进行微调，模型在OSWorld上的成功率显著提高到45.0%，相比基础模型和AgentNet训练的模型表现出显著优势。该数据集的成功应用也体现在Nemotron 3 Nano Omni模型中。
AI.keywords: 计算机使用代理, 数据集, 监督微调, 负迁移, 自动化生成, VLM, OSWorld
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入ProCUA-SFT数据集，有效解决了计算机使用代理训练中数据质量和负迁移的关键挑战。其创新之处在于全自动化的数据生成管道，利用单个VLM进行任务合成、可行性判断和轨迹执行，避免了多模型协作的复杂性。数据集的规模和多样性，以及其在UI-TARS 7B上实现的显著性能提升，凸显了其重要性。此外，ProCUA-SFT被用于训练Nemotron 3 Nano Omni模型，进一步证明了其在实际应用中的价值。

title: Federated Fair Trade Energy: Speculative Fabulation for a Planet with Limits
comments: Paper in Proceedings of LIMITS 2026: 12th Workshop on Computing within Limits, 2026-06-23-25, Online
summary: What happens to permacomputing when electricity grids shift to decentralised green energy, and local communities and municipalities have increased governance over this vital public service? Electricity and computational networks are more than just separate systems that plug together. Shifts to renewable energy generation in the grid are impacting computational systems, and computational demands on electrical power are impacting the electricity grid; one infrastructure limits the other. Permacomputing research tends to focus on 'off-grid' or 'behind-the-meter' energy. This sacrifices some of the social justice benefits that the public electricity grid, managed and regulated for universal service, was designed to provide. Our paper uses empirically-grounded 'speculative fabulation' to identify research opportunities in permacomputing that open up when energy systems are federated across communities. The speculative fabulation takes the form of an interview between the energy manager of a future energy island in the North Sea and a permacomputing podcaster. This allows us to conceive of computing-grid integration in tractable social and ecological terms, and introduce a notion of 'fair trade energy'.
