title: GSPan: A Continuous Gaussian Primitive Representation for Arbitrary-Scale Pansharpening
summary: Pansharpening aims to generate high-resolution multispectral (HRMS) images by fusing low-resolution multispectral (LRMS) and panchromatic (PAN) observations. Most existing deep learning methods treat pansharpening as fixed-grid prediction, which limits scale adaptation. To address this, we propose GSPan, a framework that introduces 2D Gaussian Splatting (GS) into pansharpening. Instead of directly predicting pixels, GSPan represents band-wise residual details as continuous and learnable 2D Gaussian primitives. We design a Dual-Stream Hierarchical Interaction (DSHI) architecture with a Spatial-Spectral Interactive Attention (SSIA) module to estimate these primitives from complementary PAN and MS observations. The predicted primitives are rendered as a residual detail field and injected into the upsampled MS image. This continuous representation allows GSPan to render fused images on arbitrary target sampling grids without scale-specific retraining. It further enables a Scale-Decoupled Asymmetric Inference (SDAI) strategy, which estimates primitives at a reduced resolution and renders the fused image at the target resolution for efficient large-scene pansharpening. Experiments on QuickBird, GaoFen-2, WorldView-3, and WorldView-3-4K datasets show that GSPan delivers state-of-the-art fusion performance. Moreover, SDAI markedly accelerates inference, achieving a favorable trade-off between computational efficiency and fusion quality. Our results demonstrate the potential of continuous Gaussian residual representations as a flexible and scale-decoupled alternative to fixed-grid prediction.

title: LongWebBench: Evaluating Structural and Functional Webpage Generation in Long-Horizon Settings
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promising progress in generating webpages from visual inputs, yet existing evaluations mainly focus on short, single-screen, and largely static webpages. We introduce LongWebBench, a benchmark for evaluating long-horizon webpage generation from both structural and functional perspectives. LongWebBench contains 490 real-world long webpages for structural fidelity evaluation and 507 goal-oriented interaction tasks over 129 webpages for functional evaluation. It employs two complementary protocols: a multi-dimensional VLM-based metric for assessing long-range structural coherence, and a DOM-augmented agent-based pipeline for end-to-end functional verification. We further examine the automatic evaluation protocols through human agreement analysis. Experiments with state-of-the-art open-source and proprietary VLMs under single-image and multi-image settings reveal that structural fidelity degrades as webpage length increases, while visually plausible generations often fail to support executable multi-step interactions. These results highlight the need to evaluate long webpage generation beyond visual similarity, with executable interaction as a core criterion. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/zheny2751-dotcom/LongWebBench.

title: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory
summary: Interactive world models aim to simulate environment dynamics under real-time user actions. However, their action vocabulary is largely confined to navigation: most actions correspond to motion (e.g., walk, turn, look around), while interaction with objects in the scene (e.g., pick up plates, open doors, or trigger physical responses) is either absent, restricted to game domains, or relegated to prompt-to-full-video scenarios. The resulting worlds are visually explorable but not truly actionable. In this work, we present ActWorld, an interactive world model that extends prior navigation-centric generators to support mid-rollout object interaction within a chunk-autoregressive framework. We argue that the navigation-interaction gap stems from two bottlenecks. First, a data bottleneck: the lack of human-object interaction data with accurate, dense labels. Second, a memory bottleneck: recency-biased history compression in existing world models discards the event-transition frames that causally determine subsequent object states, leading to an action-forgetting pathology. On the data side, we construct a 100K interaction video dataset, each annotated with per-chunk captions via chain-of-thought reasoning. On the model side, we introduce a hierarchical action-aware memory design that routes history compression by interaction importance, complemented by a persistent memory bank that maintains event-update and object-identity tokens across long rollouts. Experiments show that ActWorld supports both flexible navigation and rich object interaction within a single model, substantially improving interaction fidelity over navigation-only baselines without sacrificing viewpoint control. Project page is available at https://interactwm.github.io/ActWorld.

title: Evolutionary Algorithms and Multi-Objective Minimum Spanning Trees with Limited Distinct Weight Values
summary: Evolutionary algorithms have been used for a wide range of multi-objective combinatorial optimization problems. Despite practical success, theoretical results on the runtime of evolutionary algorithms for multi-objective combinatorial problems are rather limited. One classical problem that has been investigated is the multi-objective minimum spanning tree problem for which runtime bounds have been obtained to compute all extremal corner points of the Pareto front. With this paper, we provide some more detailed insights into the structure of the Pareto front when the edge weights take on a small number of distinct values. Based on these insights, we derive new runtime results for evolutionary multi-objective algorithms and complement our theoretical results with experimental investigations.

title: Four-Cycle Counting in Low-Degeneracy Graph Streams
summary: We study the problem of $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximating the number of four-cycles in graphs given as arbitrary order edge streams. We propose two new algorithms based on sampling induced subgraphs. Our first contribution is a two-pass algorithm that uses $\widetilde{O}(κm / \sqrt{T})$ space, where $m$ is the number of edges, $T$ is the number of four-cycles, and $κ$ is the graph's degeneracy. This algorithm improves upon existing theoretical bounds and is provably optimal for constant-degeneracy graphs, matching the known $Ω(m/\sqrt{T})$ lower bound up to lower-order factors. Our second contribution is a one-pass algorithm that remains accurate when four-cycles are not highly concentrated around individual nodes, edges, or wedges; this structural property is common in sparse social and collaboration networks. We evaluate both algorithms on a variety of real-world graph streams. The two-pass algorithm consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, using substantially less space to achieve a desired accuracy. The one-pass algorithm is competitive when four-cycles are evenly distributed, matching our theoretical analysis. Unlike several recent works, our algorithms perform well even on non-bipartite graphs such as social networks.

title: Shattering the Autoregressive Curse: Dynamic Epistemic Entropy Orchestrated Erasable Reinforcement Learning for LLMs
summary: Although reinforcement learning (RL) has expanded the cognitive boundaries of large language models (LLMs), it often remains vulnerable to the autoregressive curse in long-horizon logical reasoning: small epistemic perturbations introduced early in generation can propagate irreversibly along the Markov decision process flow, triggering cascading failures that drive the reasoning trajectory toward collapse. To overcome this autoregressive cascade, in which a single early mistake can compromise all subsequent reasoning steps, we propose dynamic epistemic entropy orchestrated erasable reinforcement learning ($\text{E}^3\text{RL}$). $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ eliminates reliance on external signals by grounding the model's endogenous local autoregressive cross-entropy as an intrinsic coordinate of epistemic uncertainty. By introducing segment-level adaptive dynamic thresholds and advantage allocation, $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ enables the model to precisely excise localized logical defects while reusing historical key-value (KV) cache streams, thereby endowing the reasoning process with a self-healing capability. We train $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ on the DeepMath-103k dataset. Experimental results show that $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ reshapes the exploration efficiency of long-sequence reasoning and improves sample efficiency while maintaining linear memory overhead. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks such as AIME, $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ achieves substantial performance gains, with the 4B and 8B parameter models surpassing previous state-of-the-art (SOTA) results by 5.349\% and 6.514\%, respectively. These findings suggest that $\text{E}^3\text{RL}$ shatters the autoregressive curse in long-sequence reasoning and establishes a theoretical and systems-level foundation for the next generation of self-healing artificial general intelligence (AGI).

title: ED3R: Energy-Aware Distributed Disaster Detection Enabled by Cooperative Robotic Agents
summary: Robotics are expected to support environmental monitoring and natural disaster management, where decisions must be made under uncertainty, resource limitations, and strict operational constraints. In critical missions, such as wildfires, robotic agents must not only identify hazardous events with sufficient confidence, but also manage the energy cost and time until detection. This paper introduces ED3R, an energy-aware distributed framework for wildfire detection under uncertainty. ED3R enables hierarchical cooperative decision-making between a robot and a remote controller. The remote controller decides upon the robot's motion, while the robot senses the environment and decides where to execute the wildfire detection (onboard or remotely) and how. The common goal is to detect wildfires with a required confidence while minimizing the energy consumed by any robot operation. ED3R further integrates mechanisms to avoid nearby obstacles, prevent redundant exploration, enable adaptive early mission completion, and ensure feasibility through a custom penalty function. ED3R also introduces a forward-looking capability, enabled through distributed neural regression models that allow the agents to anticipate the future by evaluating candidate strategies before execution. The framework is evaluated through realistic robotics simulations, ablation studies, and baseline comparisons. Overall, ED3R achieves a mission success rate of up to 97.18%. Especially in the most demanding missions, it reduces energy consumption by up to 36.4% and detects wildfires up to 41% faster than baselines.

title: A Wearable Multimodal Ultrasound+Inertial System for Real-Time Virtual Reality Interaction
summary: A-mode ultrasound (US) is a promising sensing modality for Virtual Reality (VR) interaction, as it enables the mapping of muscular activity into control commands while retaining the benefits of wearable sensing. However, existing approaches still face limitations in terms of wearability and interaction complexity, often relying on external hardware such as cameras. In this work, we propose a fully wearable multimodal interface for real-time VR-interaction, based on concurrent US and inertial (accelerometry) sensing from the forearm and upper arm. The system is built on the WULPUS platform and integrates an end-to-end software framework for real-time acquisition, visualization, and communication with a Unity-based VR environment. A multimodal learning pipeline is introduced for concurrent hand pose and forearm position estimation in 2D space. The interface is evaluated through offline and online experiments with five subjects, during the execution of three functional tasks: cylinder grasping (gross motor) and relocation, marble pinching (fine motor) and relocation, and liquid pouring. For offline experiments, we collect 5 acquisition sessions across multiple days, achieving an average inter-session accuracy across subjects of 80$\pm$6\% for hand pose estimation and 77$\pm$7\% for forearm position estimation. Online validation with minimal fine-tuning (5 min) demonstrates success rates of 92.0$\pm$16.0\%, 88.0$\pm$9.8\%, and 96.0$\pm$8.0\% for the three tasks, respectively. With a power consumption of only 19.9~mW, our system enables more than 2.5 days of continuous use on a small 350 mAh LiPo battery without the need for recharge, enabling truly wearable, multimodal, and functionally meaningful VR interaction.

title: BrainWorld: A Structural-Prior-Conditioned Generative Model for Whole-Brain 4D fMRI Dynamics
summary: Whole-brain 4D fMRI generation is valuable for modeling functional brain dynamics, yet existing fMRI foundation models mainly target representation learning and downstream prediction rather than conditional predictive generation. Evaluated on 22 datasets spanning diverse cohorts and brain states, BrainWorld generates stable 4D fMRI trajectories up to 400 frames, improves downstream performance through generated-example augmentation, and learns transferable multimodal representations that outperform baselines. Together, these results establish BrainWorld as a condition-aware generative framework for long-horizon brain dynamics modeling and multimodal representation learning.

title: Information-Theoretic Meta Dynamic Programming for Signalling and Control of POMDPs
summary: In this paper, we study the information-theoretic characterization of simultaneous signalling and control over channels modeled by partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). The problem is formulated as an optimization over randomized control strategies that maximize the directed information from actions to observations, subject to an average-cost constraint. We derive a novel dynamic programming framework in which the state is defined on the space of conditional probability distributions, leading to a high-level ``meta'' dynamic program. Specifically, we show that two coupled information states, namely, the posterior distribution of the system state and a distribution over such posteriors, satisfy Markov recursions and provide sufficient statistics for optimal control. This structure enables the decomposition of optimal strategies into separated randomized policies that depend only on these information states. Our results establish necessary and sufficient conditions for optimality and unify classical stochastic control and information-theoretic formulations. In particular, we show that in the absence of signalling, the proposed framework reduces to the standard dynamic programming equations for POMDPs. The developed approach provides a principled foundation for analyzing and designing control systems with intrinsic information constraints.

title: On the Solution of Large-scale Non-autonomous Differential Riccati Equations: a Numerical Study
summary: We explore the numerical solution of large-scale non-autonomous Differential Riccati Equations (DREs). While we assume to discretize the differential operator using a Backward Differentiation Formula (BDF) of order s, we solve the generalized Algebraic Riccati Equation (gARE) resulting at each time step by different state-of-the-art methods. In particular, we compare the performance of the inexact Newton- Kleinman method with line search and the low-rank RADI iteration, considering for both methods two different initialization strategies: zero initialization and warm-start. A comprehensive panel of numerical results illustrate the potential and limitations of these methods when employed within a numerical pipeline for the solution of DREs, rather than for the isolated solution of a single gARE, as commonly considered in the existing literature.

title: FlowCLIP: Contrastive Pretraining Using Domain Names for Encrypted Traffic Classification
summary: Network traffic classification enables website fingerprinting, intrusion detection, and Quality of Service management. However, developing methods that capture stable and generalizable traffic patterns under realistic deployment conditions remains challenging. We introduce FlowCLIP, a contrastive pretraining framework for domain name prediction from encrypted traffic using only side-channel features: packet inter-arrival times, packet sizes, and packet directions. FlowCLIP uses raw domain names as textual supervision by aligning traffic flow representations with domain name representations through a CLIP-style contrastive objective. The pretrained traffic encoder is then frozen and evaluated through linear probing on canonicalized domain name labels. We evaluate FlowCLIP on a large-scale QUIC traffic dataset using a time-based protocol, where models are trained on Week 1 traffic and evaluated on traffic from Weeks 2-4. FlowCLIP outperforms competitive machine learning baselines across later evaluation weeks, suggesting that raw domain names provide a textual supervision signal for learning transferable encrypted traffic representations.

title: Optimal placement and tuning of pointwise dampers for vibrating strings via a Lyapunov framework
summary:
We study the optimal placement and tuning of a small number of pointwise viscous dampers for a vibrating string. Starting from a finite element discretization of the damped wave equation, the system is transformed into a first-order phase-space formulation, which enables a unified Lyapunov trace framework.
  Three optimization criteria are considered: average total energy, average total displacement, and energy for a fixed initial state. For all criteria, explicit gradient formulas with respect to damper positions and viscosities are derived, requiring only one primal and one dual Lyapunov solve.
  Due to the strong non-convexity of the problem, a simple heuristic based on an explicit single-damper formula is proposed to generate effective initial guesses. Numerical examples illustrate the influence of spectral selection and discretization on the optimal damping configuration.

title: A fairness-aware extension of Stochastic Multicriteria Acceptability Analysis for ranking
summary: Fairness has become a central concern in ranking problems involving individuals or social groups, particularly under the Responsible Artificial Intelligence agenda. In Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis, Stochastic Multicriteria Acceptability Analysis (SMAA) provides a robust framework for handling uncertainty and incomplete preference information, but it does not explicitly address fairness in the resulting rankings. This paper proposes SMAA-Fair, a fairness-aware extension of SMAA for ranking problems. The approach reweights the simulated rankings generated by SMAA according to their level of group fairness, so that fairer rankings contribute more strongly to the acceptability indices and central weights vector. The framework is independent of the aggregation model and can incorporate different fairness metrics. In this study, Statistical Parity, normalized discounted Kullback--Leibler divergence (rKL) and normalized discounted cumulative Kullback--Leibler divergence (nDKL) are adopted. Rankings are derived from the fairness-adjusted acceptability matrix using expected ranking and maximum acceptability ranking. We also derive the central weight according to the degree of fairness in the obtained rankings. Numerical experiments with synthetic and real data show that SMAA-Fair improves the representation of protected groups among favourable ranking positions, while preserving robustness to preference uncertainty.

title: Time integration as filtering: a space-time discretization-aware LES formulation
comments: 6 pages, 2 figures, submitted to DLES 15 proceedings
summary: Discretization-aware LES yields an exact expression for the discrete target flux in finite-volume LES by recognizing that a coarse finite difference is a top-hat-filtered exact derivative (the "filter-swap" property). That argument is purely spatial; here we observe that the forward-Euler time difference is itself a (one-sided) top-hat-filtered exact time derivative, and repeat the construction in space-time. The resulting exact discrete flux decomposition extends the spatial one with a single temporal term: a flux-quadrature error that shrinks with the quadrature order of the time integrator. In a Burgers experiment this term grows with the CFL number while the spatial terms do not, and a Smagorinsky closure augmented with its leading order - a Lax-Wendroff-type diffusion - stays accurate at coarse time steps where space-only closures degrade.

title: Talking to Your Data: Exploring Embodied Conversation as an Interface for Personal Health Reflection
summary: Personal health data from wearables are typically presented through dashboards of charts and summary statistics, requiring users to actively interpret patterns and implications. We explore an alternative interaction paradigm: engaging with personal health data through an embodied conversational agent that facilitates objective data reflection in dialogue with the user. We present a system that combines lightweight preprocessing of wearable data with a Unity-based embodied character. Internally, the system follows a dual-agent design in which an Observer agent extracts descriptive statistics and temporal trends, and a Presenter agent communicates these findings through "spoken statistics," intentionally refraining from clinical advice to isolate the impact of the interaction modality. We evaluate this approach through a simulated-self user study (N=5) using a within-subject design. Participants adopted health personas and goals derived from the LifeSnaps dataset to compare traditional dashboard exploration with embodied conversational reflection. Our evaluation focuses on perceived understanding, the specificity of generated actions, and the cognitive shift from passive viewing to active sensemaking. The paper contributes a functional prototype, a design pattern for objective health data narrative generation, and early empirical insights into how embodiment affects the interpretation of personal health metrics.

title: Finite Difference Implementation of a High-order Space-Time Coupled Compact Gas-Kinetic Scheme
summary: This study presents a high-order compact finite difference gas-kinetic scheme (FD-CGKS) that introduces a novel spatial discretization strategy for the efficient implementation of space-time coupled high-order schemes on structured grids. A conservative nonlinear compact discretization is achieved by formulating numerical fluxes from physical fluxes at both nodal and interfacial locations. To simplify the multidimensional spatial reconstruction required for the GKS flux evaluation, we propose a dual-grid approach that updates conservative variables on both a primary grid and an identical dual grid, offset by half the mesh spacing. By leveraging the time-accurate interface solutions from the gas-kinetic evolution model, the scheme explicitly updates averaged spatial derivatives between virtual interfaces, naturally enabling compact high-order reconstruction. Furthermore, a nonlinear GENO method is incorporated to capture flow discontinuities with high resolution and robustness, effectively suppressing spurious oscillations. The proposed framework, which also offers new perspectives for designing schemes based on space-time decoupled Riemann solvers, is systematically validated. Comprehensive benchmark computations of inviscid and viscous flows demonstrate the scheme's high accuracy in resolving a wide spectrum of flow features, from smooth multiscale structures to strong shock discontinuities.

title: A Neuromorphic Trigger for Efficient Audio Event Detection
summary: Efficient processing of continuous audio streams remains a key challenge for real-time and resource-constrained systems. This paper introduces a neuromorphic trigger for audio event detection, based on a spiking neural network (SNN) that selectively gates input to downstream models. The proposed trigger acts as a low-cost front-end, identifying salient audio segments and forwarding only these to a more computationally intensive model for tasks such as classification. The trigger is implemented as a lightweight fully connected SNN and evaluated on two representative tasks: Anomalous Sound Detection (ASD) and Sound Event Detection (SED). For ASD, the trigger achieves a one-second segment-based F1 score of 0.97 on a class-agnostic form of the URBAN-SED dataset, demonstrating high reliability in identifying relevant audio regions. For SED, the trigger is combined with the Dang classifier on the DCASE 2017 Challenge Task 2 dataset, showing a potential $42.6\times$ reduction in FLOPs while reducing the lower bound of the event-based error rate from 0.41 to 0.25. These results highlight the potential of neuromorphic triggers as real-time, energy-efficient front-end filters, enabling substantial reductions in computational cost.

title: MIVE: A Minimalist Integer Vector Engine for Softmax LayerNorm and RMSNorm Acceleration
summary: The rapid growth of Large Language Models (LLMs) has intensified the need for specialized hardware accelerators that can satisfy stringent inference latency and power constraints. Although matrix multiplications dominate the overall computational workload, non-linear vector normalization operations, such as LayerNorm, RMSNorm and Softmax can become critical hardware bottlenecks. Existing accelerators typically implement these functions using dedicated hardware blocks, leading to duplicated resources and inefficient silicon utilization. To address this limitation, we propose a Minimalist Integer Vector Engine (MIVE), a programmable architecture capable of executing all three operations within a unified datapath. By exploiting common computational patterns across LayerNorm, RMSNorm and Softmax the proposed vector engine maximizes hardware sharing while reducing implementation overhead. Physical ASIC implementation results show that MIVE provides comprehensive multi-function support while achieving higher area and hardware efficiency than most state-of-the-art standalone accelerators.

title: Blind Recovery of Latent Domains via Unsupervised Symmetry Discovery
summary: Primary motivation in blind inverse problems is to recover signals of interest from corrupted observations without knowing the obfuscating mechanism. Blind deconvolution is a prominent approach when the corruption is convolutional, but it is not applicable when general linear transformations obfuscate the domain structure. In this work, we propose an unsupervised framework for recovering latent domains and signals by discovering symmetries of the data distribution. Our framework models observations as linear measurements of signals sampled from a latent random field, and optimizes a shallow group-convolutional network by imposing stationarity and locality regularization at the model output. The model learns a latent symmetry action and an appropriate filter, thereby mapping unstructured observations to a symmetry-based representation that reveals latent signals. Experiments on stochastic processes, Ising models, shuffled and bit-scrambled images, and neural recordings show that the method recovers latent domains and signals from unstructured observations, suggesting symmetry discovery as a new direction for unsupervised structure learning and blind inverse problems.

title: Is It Real? Exploiting Virtual-Physical Discrimination Vulnerability in Mixed Reality
comments: Accepted at the 2026 USENIX Symposium on Usable Privacy and Security (SOUPS 2026)
summary: Consumer mixed reality (MR) headsets seamlessly blend virtual content into physical environments with sufficient fidelity that users may be unable to distinguish virtual objects from physical ones. We identify this virtual-physical discrimination vulnerability as an exploitable security primitive. Through speculative design workshops with 12 experts from cybersecurity and MR/HCI, we develop a taxonomy of virtual-physical confusion attacks and implement four proof-of-concept attacks on Apple Vision Pro, evaluating them with 26 participants in realistic MR tasks. All four attacks altered user behavior, with success rates ranging from 85% to 100%, producing misdirected interactions, misjudged object identities, biased purchasing decisions, and altered navigation paths. Notably, the most successful attacks were also the hardest to detect according to participants' subjective ratings. Even participants who recognized virtual content still complied behaviorally, and no participant attributed anomalous events to adversarial causes. We propose platform-level provenance, interaction gating, and user education as countermeasures.

title: Toward Accessible Psychotherapy Training Using AI-Driven Interactive Patient Avatars
summary: Training psychotherapists in evidence-based interventions such as Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) requires repeated practice with meaningful feedback, yet opportunities for safe, standardized training are limited by ethical, logistical, and resource constraints. We introduce a system designed to support ACT-oriented psychotherapy training through spoken dialogue with an embodied virtual patient. The system uses large language models to simulate patient behavior conditioned on profiles derived from real therapy sessions and configurable clinical scenarios, while a separate automated evaluator provides turn-by-turn feedback on therapist responses based on established ACT fidelity criteria. Rather than aiming to replace supervision, the system is intended to support deliberate practice by enabling experimentation, reflection, and immediate feedback in low-risk settings. Expert evaluation with practicing psychologists confirmed high realism in patient behavior and demonstrated that immediate turn-by-turn ACT feedback increased therapists' awareness of intervention choices and enabled effective experimentation with alternative responses. Quantitative evaluation across 49 therapy transcripts identified GPT-4o-mini as the optimal feedback model, achieving the lowest mean absolute error (MAE = 6.12) in replicating human supervisor ACT fidelity ratings with statistically significant agreement. This work demonstrates the potential of fidelity-aware simulated patients as a scalable complement to psychotherapy training.

title: LUMEN: Coordinated Failure Recovery for Distributed LLM Serving
summary: Modern large language model (LLM) serving clusters distribute inference requests across multiple worker processes on different GPUs, but failures are prevalent at scale. When a worker fails, the cluster simultaneously loses the failed worker's GPU-resident key-value (KV) caches and serving capacity, leaving surviving workers to absorb the redirected traffic while re-running interrupted requests from scratch. Existing fault-tolerant systems either restart interrupted requests from scratch or restore KV caches from checkpoints stored on a fixed neighboring worker, but both approaches route recovery work without considering current cluster load and leave the recovering worker idle during model reload. We present LUMEN, a fault-tolerant LLM serving system that treats recovery as a load-aware coordination problem across three decision points: checkpoint placement before failures, interrupted-request distribution at failure time, and serving capacity restoration during model reload. We evaluate LUMEN using both prototype experiments and large-scale simulations and demonstrate significant improvements in serving and recovery times.

AI.title_translation: LUMEN: 分布式大语言模型推理服务的协同故障恢复
AI.tldr: LUMEN 是一种针对分布式 LLM 推理服务的容错系统，它将故障恢复视为一个负载感知的协同问题，通过在检查点放置、请求分发和模型重载阶段进行协同优化，显著缩短了故障恢复和服务时间。
AI.motivation: 在大规模分布式 LLM 推理服务中，工作节点（Worker）故障十分常见。一旦某个工作节点发生故障，其 GPU 内驻留的 KV 缓存和服务能力会同时丢失，导致存活的节点在处理重定向流量的同时，还需从头重新运行被中断的请求。现有容错系统要么完全从头重启请求，要么仅从固定的邻近节点恢复 KV 缓存，这些方法均未考虑当前集群的实时负载，且在模型重新加载期间会让恢复中的工作节点处于闲置状态。
AI.method:
提出 LUMEN 系统，将故障恢复视为一个负载感知的协同问题，并在三个决策点进行协同控制：
1. 故障发生前的检查点放置（Checkpoint placement）；
2. 故障发生时的中断请求分配（Interrupted-request distribution）；
3. 模型重新加载期间的服务能力恢复（Serving capacity restoration）。
AI.result: 原型实验和大规模模拟评估表明，与现有系统相比，LUMEN 在服务时间和恢复时间上均取得了显著的改善。
AI.conclusion: LUMEN 通过在检查点放置、请求分配和服务能力恢复三个决策点上进行负载感知的协同优化，有效解决了分布式 LLM 服务中的节点故障问题，显著缩短了故障恢复时间并提升了集群的整体服务性能。
AI.translation: 现代大语言模型（LLM）服务集群将推理请求分发到不同 GPU 上的多个工作进程中，但在大规模场景下，故障十分普遍。当一个工作节点发生故障时，集群会同时失去该故障工作节点上驻留在 GPU 中的键值（KV）缓存和服务能力，导致幸存的工作节点在从头开始重新运行中断请求的同时，还必须吸收重定向的流量。现有的容错系统要么从头开始重新启动中断的请求，要么从存储在固定邻近工作节点上的检查点恢复 KV 缓存，但这两种方法在路由恢复工作时都没有考虑当前的集群负载，并且在模型重新加载期间会让正在恢复的工作节点处于闲置状态。我们提出了 LUMEN，这是一个容错的 LLM 服务系统，它将恢复视为跨三个决策点的负载感知协同问题：故障前的检查点放置、故障发生时的中断请求分配，以及模型重新加载期间的服务能力恢复。我们使用原型实验和大规模模拟对 LUMEN 进行了评估，结果表明其在服务和恢复时间上均有显著改善。
AI.summary: 本文针对分布式大语言模型（LLM）推理服务中的节点故障问题，提出了容错服务系统 LUMEN。LUMEN 将故障恢复视为一个跨阶段的负载感知协同问题，通过在故障前合理放置检查点、故障时智能分发中断请求以及在模型重载期间恢复服务能力，有效降低了故障对集群服务性能的影响。实验表明该系统能显著缩短服务和故障恢复时间。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型服务 (LLM Serving), 故障恢复 (Failure Recovery), 键值缓存 (KV Cache), 容错系统 (Fault-Tolerant Systems)
AI.comments:
创新性：LUMEN 的创新之处在于将 LLM 服务中的故障恢复重新定义为一个跨越故障前、中、后三个阶段的“负载感知协同问题”，打破了传统容错机制（如简单重启或固定邻节点备份）的静态局限。
重要性：在大规模 LLM 分布式推理中，GPU 故障频繁发生，且 KV 缓存的丢失会导致巨大的重新计算开销。LUMEN 通过协同优化，对保证高并发、低延迟的 LLM 在线服务的可用性具有重要意义。
局限性：摘要中未提及检查点备份（checkpoint placement）带来的额外显存/内存开销以及网络带宽占用，这在实际部署中可能是关键瓶颈。

title: Mind Companion: An Embodied Conversational Agent for Process-Based Psychotherapy
summary: Access to evidence-based psychotherapy remains limited worldwide, with long waitlists even in high-income regions. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer potential for scalable mental health support when designed with clinical oversight and safety mechanisms. We present Mind Companion, an LLM-based embodied conversational agent integrating multi-layered psychological analysis with process-based therapy principles. The system performs real-time analysis of client statements across fact extraction, psychological flexibility process detection, emotion recognition, and safety monitoring. Analysis results are stored for supervising clinicians to inform therapeutic planning. Response generation incorporates retrieval-augmented generation from evidence-based therapeutic literature and context-aware prompting. Responses are delivered through an embodied avatar with synchronized speech synthesis and animation. We evaluated three LLM configurations (GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5) against therapist responses from real therapy sessions using automated LLM-judge assessment and expert evaluation with 11 professional psychotherapists. GPT-5.2 achieved higher ratings than human therapist responses across understanding, interpersonal effectiveness, collaboration, and therapeutic alignment in both evaluations, demonstrating the feasibility of LLM-based conversational agents as tools to complement clinical care.

AI.title_translation: Mind Companion：一种用于基于过程的心理治疗的具身对话智能体
AI.tldr: 本文开发了Mind Companion，一个结合多层心理分析与基于过程治疗原则的LLM具身对话智能体，其在评估中（特别是GPT-5.2配置）在理解力和治疗一致性等指标上超越了人类治疗师。
AI.motivation: 全球范围内获取循证心理治疗的机会仍然有限，即使在高收入地区也存在漫长的等待名单。大语言模型（LLM）在临床监督和安全机制下，有望提供可扩展的精神健康支持，以缓解这一供需矛盾。
AI.method: 提出Mind Companion系统，该系统包含以下核心设计：（1）多层次实时分析：对来访者陈述进行事实提取、心理灵活性过程检测、情绪识别和安全监测；（2）临床监督支持：将分析结果存储供临床医生参考并指导治疗计划；（3）回复生成：结合循证治疗文献的检索增强生成（RAG）和上下文感知提示；（4）具身交互：通过具有同步语音合成和动画的具身虚拟人（avatar）向用户呈现回复。
AI.result: 使用自动LLM裁判评估和11位专业心理治疗师的专家评估，对三种LLM配置（GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.5）与真实治疗会话中的人类治疗师回复进行了对比。结果显示，GPT-5.2在理解力、人际交往有效性、协作性和治疗一致性等所有评估维度上，得分均高于人类治疗师的回复。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的对话智能体具有作为辅助临床护理工具的可行性，能够提供高质量、符合治疗规范的互动支持。
AI.translation: 全球范围内获取循证心理治疗的机会仍然有限，即使在高收入地区也存在漫长的等待名单。最近大语言模型（LLM）的进展，在设计有临床监督和安全机制的前提下，为可扩展的精神健康支持提供了潜力。我们展示了 Mind Companion，这是一个基于 LLM 的具身对话智能体，它将多层次的心理分析与基于过程的治疗原则相结合。该系统对来访者的陈述进行实时分析，涵盖事实提取、心理灵活性过程检测、情绪识别和安全监测。分析结果被存储起来，以供监督临床医生参考并指导治疗计划。回复生成结合了来自循证治疗文献的检索增强生成（RAG）和上下文感知提示。回复通过具有同步语音合成和动画的具身虚拟人进行呈现。我们使用自动 LLM 裁判评估以及 11 位专业心理治疗师的专家评估，将三种 LLM 配置（GPT-4.1-mini、GPT-5.2、Claude Sonnet 4.5）与真实治疗会话中的治疗师回复进行了对比评估。在两项评估中，GPT-5.2 在理解力、人际交往有效性、协作性和治疗一致性方面均获得了高于人类治疗师回复的评分，证明了基于 LLM 的对话智能体作为辅助临床护理工具的可行性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Mind Companion，这是一种基于大语言模型的具身对话智能体，旨在辅助进行基于过程的心理治疗。该系统能够实时分析用户心理状态、安全风险，并结合循证治疗文献和上下文生成专业回复，最终通过具身虚拟人进行交互。通过自动和11位专业心理治疗师的评估，GPT-5.2配置在多项关键治疗指标上超越了人类治疗师，展示了其作为临床辅助工具的潜力。
AI.keywords: 具身对话智能体, 心理治疗, 大语言模型, 检索增强生成, 基于过程的治疗
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将最前沿的大语言模型（LLM）与具体的心理治疗流派（基于过程的治疗，PBT）及具身智能（Avatar）相结合，并引入了严谨的多层心理分析和安全监控机制。令人瞩目的是，GPT-5.2在多项指标上超越了人类治疗师的回复。然而，摘要中未详细说明其在面对极端心理危机时的具体安全兜底表现，且在实际临床应用中的长期疗效和人机信任等伦理问题仍需在未来研究中进一步探讨。

title: The Slop Paradox: How Synthetic Standardization Erodes Clinical Uncertainty and Cross-Modal Alignment in AI-Rewritten Radiology Reports
summary: AI-assisted clinical documentation tools increasingly summarize, standardize, and reformat radiology reports using large language models (LLMs). We present a controlled measurement of the resulting information degradation. Using 450 chest X-ray reports from the Indiana University dataset, we generate synthetic versions via three realistic LLM rewriting tasks: EHR summarization, standardized rewriting, and teaching case preparation. We measure entity erosion (via medical NER), hedging collapse (loss of clinical uncertainty language), and cross-modal alignment degradation (via BiomedCLIP image-text similarity). Our central finding is a dissociation between information loss and cross-modal fidelity. EHR summarization is the most destructive at the content level, eroding 51.4% of clinical entities and 43.7% of hedging language, yet it preserves image-text alignment almost entirely (a 2.5% drop). The two tasks meant to produce cleaner training data, standardized rewriting and teaching case preparation, do the reverse: they preserve more entities (26.8% and 29.3% eroded) but cause 14.9-16.5% alignment drops, six to seven times those of EHR summarization. We term this the slop paradox: rewriting that makes clinical text look cleaner for multimodal training is precisely what pulls it away from the image. Contrary to our pre-specified hypothesis, rare pathologies were not preferentially degraded: across nine rare-versus-common comparisons, no difference survived multiple-comparison correction, and nominal differences ran in the opposite direction (common > rare), so contamination is invisible to condition-specific monitoring. The dominant determinant of degradation is the type of AI rewriting task, not the clinical content. These findings bear on multimodal medical AI dataset construction and the governance of AI-assisted clinical documentation.

AI.title_translation: Slop悖论：合成标准化如何侵蚀AI重写放射学报告中的临床不确定性与跨模态对齐
AI.tldr: 研究揭示了“Slop悖论”：使用大模型对放射学报告进行标准化重写虽然使文本看起来更干净，但实际上严重破坏了图像与文本之间的跨模态对齐。
AI.motivation: 评估和定量测量大语言模型（LLM）在重写、简化和标准化放射学报告时，所导致的信息退化（包括临床实体流失、临床不确定性语言减少以及跨模态图文对齐退化）。
AI.method: 使用印第安纳大学数据集中的450份胸部X光报告，通过三种LLM重写任务（电子病历摘要、标准化重写、教学案例准备）生成合成报告。通过医学命名实体识别（NER）测量实体侵蚀，通过临床不确定性语言流失测量套期保值崩溃（hedging collapse），并使用BiomedCLIP图像-文本相似度测量跨模态对齐退化。
AI.result: 电子病历（EHR）摘要对内容破坏最大（流失51.4%实体和43.7%不确定性语言），但几乎完全保留了图文对齐（仅下降2.5%）。相反，旨在提供更干净数据的标准化重写和教学案例准备虽然保留了更多实体，但导致图文对齐度下降14.9%-16.5%（是EHR摘要的6-7倍），即“Slop悖论”。此外，罕见病变并未比常见病变降级更严重，降级的主要决定因素是AI重写任务的类型，而非临床内容。
AI.conclusion: 用于多模态训练的AI文本重写（使其看起来更干净、更规范）反而会使其在语义上偏离对应的图像（即“Slop悖论”）。这些发现对于多模态医学AI数据集的构建以及AI辅助临床文档的治理和规范具有重要意义。
AI.translation: AI辅助的临床文档工具越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）来总结、标准化和重新格式化放射学报告。我们对由此产生的信息降级进行了受控测量。利用印第安纳大学数据集中的450份胸部X光报告，我们通过三种现实的LLM重写任务（电子病历摘要、标准化重写和教学案例准备）生成了合成版本。我们测量了实体侵蚀（通过医学命名实体识别）、套期保值崩溃（临床不确定性语言的流失）以及跨模态对齐退化（通过BiomedCLIP图文相似度）。我们的核心发现是信息流失与跨模态保真度之间存在分离。电子病历摘要在内容层面的破坏性最大，侵蚀了51.4%的临床实体和43.7%的套期保值语言，但它几乎完全保留了图文对齐（仅下降2.5%）。而旨在产生更清洁训练数据的两项任务——标准化重写和教学案例准备，结果却恰恰相反：它们保留了更多实体（分别侵蚀26.8%和29.3%），但导致了14.9%至16.5%的对齐度下降，是电子病历摘要的六到七倍。我们称之为“Slop悖论”：使临床文本在多模态训练中看起来更干净的重写，恰恰是将其拉离图像的原因。与我们预先设定的假设相反，罕见病变并没有被优先降级：在九次罕见与常见的对比中，没有差异在多重比较校正后存活下来，且标称差异走向相反（常见 > 罕见），因此这种污染对特定病况的监测是不可见的。降级的主导决定因素是AI重写任务的类型，而非临床内容。这些发现对多模态医学AI数据集的构建和AI辅助临床文档的治理具有重要启示。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用大语言模型（LLM）重写放射学报告对临床信息和多模态图文对齐的影响。研究发现，旨在使文本更规范、更干净的AI重写任务（如标准化和教学案例准备）虽然保留了较多的医学实体，但却严重破坏了图像与文本之间的跨模态对齐；而信息删减最严重的电子病历（EHR）摘要反而能很好地保持图文对齐。作者将这种现象称为“Slop悖论”，并指出AI重写任务类型是导致信息和对齐度降级的主要因素。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 放射学报告, 跨模态对齐, 临床不确定性, Slop悖论
AI.comments: 这项研究非常有警示意义，它挑战了“更干净、更标准化的文本有利于多模态模型训练”的直觉假设，首次提出了“Slop悖论”，揭示了合成数据在医学多模态对齐中的潜在陷阱。其局限性在于仅使用了胸部X光报告（印第安纳大学数据集），未来需要验证这一结论在其他医学影像模态（如MRI、CT）或更广泛的临床场景中的普适性。

title: ARES: A Platform for Adaptive Role-Based Evaluation of Social Engineering Risks in Human--AI Games
comments: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the International Carnahan Conference on Security Technology (ICCST 2026)
summary: This work introduces ARES, a platform and open pilot dataset for auditing adaptive social engineering risks in LLM-mediated social decision-making through controlled social games. ARES supports human--human, human--AI, and AI--AI settings, combining configurable game templates, role-conditioned LLM agents, psychology-informed participant profiling, structured interaction trees, and synchronised behavioural and biometric acquisition, filtering, and deep-learning-based feature extraction. The pilot dataset was collected from 15 participants interacting with a role-conditioned GPT-5.4 agent in two concatenated games: an adapted Prisoner's Dilemma and an Ultimatum Game. It comprises 340 GB of raw and processed multimodal data across six streams: interaction logs, video, screen recordings, gaze logs, smartwatch signals, and game/questionnaire metadata. These data include interaction paths, written justifications, psychological profiles, subjective feedback, perceived counterpart identity, game outcomes, and derived behavioural, facial, and gaze features. Alongside the dataset, we provide descriptive analyses to characterise the pilot release. Rigorous risk evaluation is essential for the deployment of secure AI systems, as it enables the identification and mitigation of vulnerabilities, ensures the protection of sensitive data, and supports compliance with evolving regulatory and ethical standards in society.
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the International Carnahan Conference on Security Technology (ICCST 2026)

AI.title_translation: ARES：人机博弈中基于自适应角色的社会工程学风险评估平台
AI.tldr: 本文推出了ARES平台，用于评估人机博弈中的自适应社会工程学风险，并提供了一个包含340 GB多模态行为和生理数据的开源试点数据集。
AI.motivation: 在大语言模型（LLM）介导的社会决策中，需要对自适应社会工程学风险进行严格的评估，以识别和缓解安全漏洞、保护敏感数据，并符合不断发展的监管和伦理标准。
AI.method: 提出ARES平台，支持人-人、人-AI和AI-AI交互，结合了可配置游戏模板、角色条件化LLM智能体、心理学参与者画像、结构化交互树以及同步的多模态行为与生理特征采集。利用该平台，让15名参与者与角色条件化的GPT-5.4智能体在改良的囚徒困境和最后通牒博弈中进行交互，从而收集多模态数据。
AI.result: 成功开发了ARES平台，并收集并提供了一个包含340 GB原始和处理后多模态数据的试点数据集（涵盖交互日志、视频、屏幕录制、视线日志、智能手表信号和问卷元数据等六个数据流），同时提供了描述性分析来表征该数据集。
AI.conclusion: 严格的风险评估对于部署安全的AI系统至关重要，ARES平台及其多模态数据集有助于识别和缓解AI系统中的社会工程学漏洞，确保敏感数据安全，并支持社会监管与伦理合规。
AI.translation: 本工作介绍了 ARES，这是一个用于通过受控社会博弈来审计大语言模型（LLM）介导的社会决策中自适应社会工程学风险的平台和开源试点数据集。ARES 支持人-人、人-AI 和 AI-AI 设置，结合了可配置的游戏模板、角色条件化的 LLM 智能体、基于心理学的参与者画像、结构化交互树，以及同步的行为和生物特征获取、过滤和基于深度学习的特征提取。该试点数据集收集自 15 名参与者与角色条件化 GPT-5.4 智能体在两个串联博弈（改良的囚徒困境和最后通牒博弈）中的交互。它包含 340 GB 的原始和处理后的多模态数据，跨越六个数据流：交互日志、视频、屏幕录制、视线日志、智能手表信号以及博弈/问卷元数据。这些数据包括交互路径、书面理由、心理画像、主观反馈、感知到的对手身份、博弈结果，以及派生的行为、面部和视线特征。除了数据集之外，我们还提供了描述性分析来表征该试点版本的特征。严格的风险评估对于部署安全的 AI 系统至关重要，因为它能够识别和缓解漏洞，确保敏感数据的保护，并支持符合社会中不断发展的监管和伦理标准。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ARES平台，这是一个用于在人机博弈中评估大语言模型（LLM）自适应社会工程学风险的系统。该平台支持多种交互模式，并结合了心理画像与多模态生理数据采集。作者还发布了一个包含340 GB多模态数据的试点数据集，记录了人类与GPT-5.4智能体在博弈中的交互，为AI系统的安全风险评估和缓解提供了支持。
AI.keywords: 社会工程学风险, 人机博弈, 多模态数据集, 大语言模型, ARES平台
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多模态行为与生理数据（如视线日志、智能手表信号）引入到人机博弈的社会工程学风险评估中，提供了一个非常独特且维度丰富的开源数据集。然而，试点数据集的参与者人数较少（仅15人），其结论的普适性可能需要更大规模的数据来进一步验证。此外，摘要中提到的“GPT-5.4”智能体也展示了该研究在前沿模型安全评估上的前瞻性。

title: LiveStarPro: Proactive Streaming Video Understanding with Hierarchical Memory for Long-Horizon Streams
summary: Despite the remarkable progress of Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs), current online architectures still struggle to simultaneously process continuous video streams, decide autonomously when to respond, and preserve long-horizon contextual memory. These obstacles undermine real-time responsiveness and cause severe forgetting throughout prolonged interactions. In this work, we introduce LiveStarPro, a live streaming assistant that is designed for proactive video understanding over long-horizon streams. The design of LiveStarPro rests on three complementary components. The first component is Streaming Verification Decoding (SVeD), an inference framework that identifies the appropriate response timing through single-pass perplexity verification, thereby eliminating the dependency on explicit silence tokens. The second component is Streaming Causal Attention Masks (SCAM), a training strategy that enforces incremental video-language alignment over variable-length streams. The third component is Tree-Structured Hierarchical Memory (TSHM), a recursive memory architecture that organizes evicted historical information into event chains and consequently enables efficient retrieval from effectively unbounded video streams. To facilitate a comprehensive evaluation under realistic online conditions, we further present OmniStarPro, a large-scale benchmark that spans 15 diverse real-world scenarios and that extends to hour-scale streams for the assessment of long-term recall. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiveStarPro consistently surpasses existing methods, attaining a 28.9% improvement in semantic correctness and an 18.2% reduction in timing error, while its streaming key-value cache further yields a 1.58x inference speedup over the same model without caching. The model and the code are publicly available at https://github.com/sotayang/LiveStarPro.

AI.title_translation: LiveStarPro：基于分层记忆的长视频流主动流式视频理解
AI.tldr: LiveStarPro通过流式验证解码、因果注意力掩码和树状分层记忆，实现了对长视频流的高效主动理解，显著提升了响应时机准确性、语义正确性并加速了推理。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）在处理连续视频流时，难以同时做到自主决定响应时机以及保留长期上下文记忆，这导致了实时响应性差以及在长时间交互中出现严重遗忘的问题。
AI.method:
提出了一种名为LiveStarPro的直播助手系统，包含三个核心组件：
1. 流式验证解码（SVeD）：通过单阶段困惑度验证来识别合适的响应时机，无需显式的静音标记。
2. 流式因果注意力掩码（SCAM）：一种训练策略，用于在可变长度视频流上强制执行增量的视频-语言对齐。
3. 树状结构分层记忆（TSHM）：一种递归记忆架构，将淘汰的历史信息组织成事件链，实现对无限视频流的高效检索。
此外，还构建了一个名为OmniStarPro的大规模、小时级流式视频评估基准。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，LiveStarPro在语义正确性上提升了28.9%，在响应时机误差上减少了18.2%。同时，其流式键值（KV）缓存机制相比于无缓存的同等模型实现了1.58倍的推理加速。
AI.conclusion: LiveStarPro通过其创新的解码、注意力和记忆机制，成功解决了长视频流理解中的实时响应、增量对齐和长期遗忘问题，在语义正确性、响应时机和推理速度上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 尽管视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）取得了显著进展，但当前的在线架构仍难以同时处理连续的视频流、自主决定何时做出回应，并保留长期的上下文记忆。这些障碍削弱了实时响应能力，并在长时间的交互中导致严重的遗忘。在这项工作中，我们推出了 LiveStarPro，这是一款专为长视频流上的主动视频理解而设计的直播助手。LiveStarPro 的设计基于三个互补的组件。第一个组件是流式验证解码（SVeD），这是一个通过单阶段困惑度验证来识别合适响应时机的推理框架，从而消除了对显式静音标记的依赖。第二个组件是流式因果注意力掩码（SCAM），这是一种在可变长度视频流上强制执行增量视频-语言对齐的训练策略。第三个组件是树状结构分层记忆（TSHM），这是一种递归记忆架构，它将淘汰的历史信息组织成事件链，从而能够从无限的视频流中进行高效检索。为了便于在现实的在线条件下进行全面评估，我们进一步提出了 OmniStarPro，这是一个跨越 15 个不同真实场景的大规模基准，并延伸至小时级视频流以评估长期召回能力。广泛的实验表明，LiveStarPro 始终超越现有方法，在语义正确性上提高了 28.9%，在时机误差上减少了 18.2%，同时其流式键值缓存与不带缓存的相同模型相比，进一步实现了 1.58 倍的推理加速。该模型和代码可在 https://github.com/sotayang/LiveStarPro 公开获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LiveStarPro，一个用于长视频流主动理解的直播助手系统。该系统通过流式验证解码（SVeD）自主决策响应时机，利用流式因果注意力掩码（SCAM）实现增量视频-语言对齐，并采用树状结构分层记忆（TSHM）来解决长时间交互中的遗忘问题。此外，本文还推出了OmniStarPro基准以评估长视频流理解能力。实验证明了该方法在准确性、时机控制和推理速度上的优越性。
AI.keywords: 视频大语言模型, 主动视频理解, 流式视频, 分层记忆, 实时交互
AI.comments: 该论文针对长视频流实时理解提出了一个非常系统且实用的解决方案。其主要创新点在于将响应时机预测（SVeD）、增量对齐（SCAM）和长期记忆检索（TSHM）有机结合，有效解决了实时交互中的延迟、对齐和遗忘问题。特别是TSHM将历史信息构建为树状事件链，在保障无限流检索效率的同时降低了显存开销。此外，提出的小时级基准OmniStarPro对于评估长视频流模型具有重要现实意义。

title: Position: Coding Benchmarks Are Misaligned with Agentic Software Engineering
summary: Coding agents have become a major mode of software engineering, but the benchmarks we use to compare them were designed in a pre-agent era: they collapse model, harness, and environment into a single end-to-end score, typically computed against one reference solution, with no component-level signal for iteration. We argue that current coding benchmarks are misaligned with agentic software engineering. A coding agent in practice is not a model: it is a system harness -- a composite of models, harnesses, contexts, environments, and feedback signals, any one of which can move the benchmark score by margins comparable to those between adjacent model generations. We discuss three symptoms: (i) benchmark scores conflate the model with the rest of the harness; (ii) grading against a single reference solution penalises equally valid alternatives; and (iii) the absence of signal at the level of individual harness components makes the end-to-end system score difficult to iterate on.

AI.title_translation: 观点：编码基准测试与智能体化软件工程不匹配
AI.tldr: 现有的代码基准测试将模型、测试套件和环境混为一谈，且缺乏组件级的反馈，这与实际中作为复杂系统的编码智能体是不匹配的。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已成为软件工程的重要模式，但现有的基准测试设计于“前智能体时代”。它们将模型、测试套件和环境混为一谈，仅给出一个端到端的分数，且缺乏组件级的反馈信号，导致无法有效指导智能体系统的迭代与优化。
AI.method: 本文属于观点/立场论文（Position Paper）。作者通过系统性分析，指出实践中的编码智能体是一个由模型、上下文、环境和反馈组成的复杂系统，并详细论述了当前基准测试在评估该系统时存在的三个核心症状（混淆模型与套件、单一参考解惩罚有效替代方案、缺乏组件级信号）。
AI.result: 指出当前编码基准测试与智能体软件工程不匹配的三个主要症状：（1）基准分数无法区分模型本身与测试套件其他部分的影响；（2）依赖单一参考答案的评估方式会误判其他同样有效的代码实现；（3）缺乏细粒度的组件级反馈，使得端到端系统难以进行针对性迭代。
AI.conclusion: 当前的编码基准测试与实际的智能体软件工程不匹配。评估编码智能体需要能够区分系统各组件（模型、环境、反馈等）贡献并提供组件级反馈的新型基准测试方法，而不是仅依赖单一参考答案的端到端评分。
AI.translation: 编码智能体已成为软件工程的一种主要模式，但我们用于比较它们的基准测试是在“前智能体时代”设计的：它们将模型、测试套件（harness）和环境折叠为一个单一的端到端分数，通常是针对一个参考解决方案计算的，没有用于迭代的组件级信号。我们认为，当前的代码基准测试与智能体化软件工程是不匹配的。在实践中，编码智能体并不是一个模型：它是一个系统套件——由模型、套件、上下文、环境和反馈信号组成，其中任何一个组件对基准测试分数的影响程度都可能与相邻模型代际之间的差距相当。我们讨论了三个症状：（i）基准测试分数将模型与套件的其他部分混为一谈；（ii）针对单一参考解决方案进行评分会惩罚同样有效的替代方案；以及（iii）在单个套件组件级别上缺乏信号，使得端到端系统分数难以进行迭代。
AI.summary: 本文指出当前的编码基准测试与智能体化软件工程存在严重脱节。实际中的编码智能体是一个包含模型、环境和反馈等多个组件的复杂系统，而现有基准测试仅提供单一的端到端分数并依赖单一参考答案，这导致无法准确评估各组件的贡献，也难以指导系统的迭代优化。
AI.keywords: 编码智能体, 基准测试, 智能体软件工程, 系统套件, 评估方法
AI.comments: 这是一篇及时且具有前瞻性的观点论文。随着软件工程领域向基于Agent的开发模式转变，传统的、单一指标的端到端代码基准测试（如SWE-bench等）确实面临无法解耦评估的困境。本文清晰地指出了现有评估框架的局限性，对于未来构建更科学、多维度、模块化的Agent评估基准具有重要的引导和规范作用。

title: MaineCoon: Pursuing A Real-Time Audio-Visual Social World Model
summary: As an increasing majority of global video content is consumed on social platforms for interactive social purposes, video generation models built for social worlds are important but largely overlooked by previous studies. In this work, we define the position of social world models and build a prototype model as the first step towards this goal. While previous world models successfully simulate physical environments or gaming world exploration, they remain fundamentally detached from human-centric social dynamics. To bridge this gap as the first step to social world models, we present MaineCoon, the first real-time audio-visual autoregressive model that has 22B parameters and is capable of real-time streaming generation and sub-second interaction, with a record-breaking frame rate of up to 47.5 FPS, on a single GPU. To the best of our knowledge, MaineCoon is also the first real-time audio-visual generation model specifically optimized for social-interactive applications. To enable efficient and stable training, we introduce several novel techniques into MaineCoon, including self-resampling, cross-modal representation alignment, domain-aware preference optimization, and reinforced online-policy distillation (ROPD). We also design the first agentic streaming inference framework that supports thousand-second-scale or even longer generation while mitigating drift with agentic cache management and prompt planing. These innovations significantly accelerate training while optimizing real-time inference performance. We believe this work not only sets a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance benchmark for high-quality, low-latency, and long-horizon audio-visual autoregressive models, but also points out the paradigm shift desired for next-generation AI-native social platforms.

AI.title_translation: MaineCoon：追求实时音视频社交世界模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了MaineCoon，这是首个拥有22B参数、专为社交互动优化的实时音视频自回归模型，在单GPU上实现了创纪录的47.5 FPS生成速度和亚秒级交互。
AI.motivation: 虽然现有的世界模型能够成功模拟物理环境或游戏世界，但它们与以人为中心的社交动态脱节。随着社交平台互动视频需求的增长，开发能够模拟社交互动的“社交世界模型”至关重要，但此前这一领域基本被忽视。
AI.method:
提出MaineCoon模型（22B参数），并引入了以下关键技术：
1. 自重采样（self-resampling）与跨模态表示对齐；
2. 领域感知偏好优化与强化在线策略蒸馏（ROPD），以实现高效稳定的训练；
3. 智能体流式推理框架，利用智能体缓存管理和提示规划来缓解长序列生成中的漂移问题。
AI.result: MaineCoon在单张GPU上实现了创纪录的47.5 FPS帧率，支持亚秒级交互和实时流式生成，并且能够支持长达千秒级甚至更长时间的超长视频生成，显著加速了训练并优化了推理性能。
AI.conclusion: MaineCoon不仅在高质量、低延迟和长周期的音视频自回归模型上树立了新的SOTA性能基准，还为下一代AI原生社交平台的发展指明了范式转变的方向。
AI.translation: 随着全球绝大多数视频内容越来越多地在社交平台上用于互动社交目的，为社交世界构建的视频生成模型虽然重要，但在以往的研究中很大程度上被忽视了。在这项工作中，我们定义了社交世界模型的位置，并构建了一个原型模型作为迈向这一目标的第一步。虽然以前的世界模型成功地模拟了物理环境或游戏世界的探索，但它们在根本上与以人为中心的社交动态脱节。为了缩小这一差距并作为迈向社交世界模型的第一步，我们提出了MaineCoon，这是第一个实时的音视频自回归模型，拥有220亿（22B）参数，能够在单个GPU上进行实时流式生成和亚秒级交互，帧率达到创纪录的47.5 FPS。据我们所知，MaineCoon也是第一个专门针对社交互动应用进行优化的实时音视频生成模型。为了实现高效且稳定的训练，我们在MaineCoon中引入了数项新技术，包括自重采样、跨模态表示对齐、领域感知偏好优化和强化在线策略蒸馏（ROPD）。我们还设计了首个智能体流式推理框架，该框架支持千秒级甚至更长时间的生成，同时通过智能体缓存管理和提示规划来缓解漂移。这些创新在优化实时推理性能的同时，显著加速了训练。我们相信，这项工作不仅为高质量、低延迟和长周期的音视频自回归模型树立了新的最先进（SOTA）性能基准，而且指出了下一代AI原生社交平台所期望的范式转变。
AI.summary: 本文推出了MaineCoon，这是首个专为社交互动应用优化的22B参数实时音视频自回归社交世界模型。为了克服传统世界模型缺乏人类社交动态的局限性，MaineCoon通过引入自重采样、跨模态对齐、领域感知偏好优化及强化在线策略蒸馏等技术，并在推理端结合智能体流式框架，在单GPU上实现了高达47.5 FPS的超低延迟音视频生成，支持千秒级以上的长周期流式交互。
AI.keywords: 社交世界模型, 音视频生成, 实时自回归模型, 智能体流式推理, 低延迟
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：首次明确提出了“社交世界模型（Social World Model）”的概念，填补了现有世界模型在人机/人际社交动态模拟上的空白。
2. 实用性极强：在单张GPU上实现了高达47.5 FPS的超低延迟生成，支持亚秒级交互，展示了极高的工程优化水平。
3. 架构设计精妙：引入了强化在线策略蒸馏（ROPD）和智能体流式推理框架，成功解决了长视频生成中的“漂移”难题。

title: Continual Self-Improvement with Lightweight Experiential Latent Memories
summary: Large language models achieve strong reasoning performance by scaling inference-time compute, yet remain fundamentally stateless, discarding the rich, self-produced reasoning traces generated during this process. We investigate whether models can instead learn online from this experience, converting transient computation (reasoning traces) into persistent reusable knowledge, and without external supervision or access to future data. We show that In-Context Learning (ICL) over raw reasoning traces fails to generalize, reflecting a fundamental limitation of token-level reuse: individual traces lack the abstraction needed for transfer, even after refinement (e.g. self-reflection). In contrast, drawing inspiration from recent works on unsupervised reinforcement learning, we find that lightweight per-instance training with self-generated test-time signals (majority voting) as rewards yields substantial gains, often surpassing full-dataset offline training, motivating a shift from raw traces to learned latent representations. Building on this insight, we propose an online method that distills inference-time compute spent on encountered problems into compact modular latent memories capturing the underlying reasoning structure. These memories are stored and retrieved for future inputs, enabling continual improvement while avoiding catastrophic forgetting through modular design. Importantly, our method is highly efficient, parametrized as extremely lightweight soft prompt memories (~0.001% of model parameters) and trained with only a few gradient steps, yet achieving performance competitive with full parametric updates and offline training. Across challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, our approach significantly outperforms zero-shot and raw data ICL baselines, while transferring effectively across datasets.

AI.title_translation: 基于轻量级体验隐式记忆的持续自我提升
AI.tldr: 提出一种在线学习方法，通过将推理计算转化为极轻量级的模块化隐式记忆（软提示），使大模型能从自身推理轨迹中持续学习，避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然能通过扩展推理时计算获得强大的推理能力，但它们本质上是无状态的，会丢弃推理过程中产生的丰富自我生成轨迹。而直接在原始推理轨迹上进行上下文学习（ICL）由于缺乏抽象能力而难以泛化。因此，研究如何在无外部监督或未来数据的情况下，让模型在线学习这些经验，将瞬时计算转化为持久的可重用知识，是本文的出发点。
AI.method: 提出一种在线方法，将模型在解决问题时消耗的推理时计算蒸馏（distill）为紧凑的模块化隐式记忆（modular latent memories），用于捕捉底层的推理结构。这些记忆被参数化为极轻量级的软提示（约占模型参数的0.001%），仅需少数梯度步骤进行训练。这些记忆会被存储并针对未来的输入进行检索，通过模块化设计实现持续改进并避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在挑战性的数学推理基准测试中，该方法显著优于零样本（zero-shot）和原始数据上下文学习（ICL）基线，且能有效跨数据集迁移。该方法极其高效（仅需训练~0.001%的参数和极少的梯度步骤），其性能可与全参数更新和离线训练相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 通过将推理时计算转化为轻量级的模块化隐式记忆（软提示），大语言模型能够在不依赖外部监督的情况下实现高效的在线自提升，并在避免灾难性遗忘的同时，在数学推理任务中展现出强大的泛化与跨数据集迁移能力。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型通过扩展推理时计算实现了强大的推理性能，但它们本质上仍然是无状态的，丢弃了在此过程中产生的、由自身生成的丰富推理轨迹。我们研究了模型是否可以转而从这些经验中进行在线学习，在没有外部监督或接触未来数据的情况下，将瞬时计算（推理轨迹）转化为持久的可重用知识。我们表明，在原始推理轨迹上进行上下文学习（ICL）无法泛化，这反映了 token 级重用的根本局限性：即使经过改进（例如自我反思），单个轨迹也缺乏迁移所需的抽象能力。相反，受到最近无监督强化学习工作的启发，我们发现利用自我生成的测试时信号（多数投票）作为奖励进行轻量级的单实例训练可以带来显著的收益，甚至往往超过全数据集离线训练，这激发了从原始轨迹向学习到的隐式表示的转变。基于这一见解，我们提出了一种在线方法，将遇到问题时消耗的推理时计算蒸馏为捕捉底层推理结构的紧凑模块化隐式记忆。这些记忆会被存储并针对未来的输入进行检索，从而在通过模块化设计避免灾难性遗忘的同时，实现持续改进。重要的是，我们的方法非常高效，参数化为极轻量级的软提示记忆（约占模型参数的 0.001%），且仅需少数字步长训练，但其性能可与全参数更新和离线训练相媲美。在具有挑战性的数学推理基准上，我们的方法显著优于零样本和原始数据 ICL 基线，同时能跨数据集进行有效迁移。
AI.summary: 针对大语言模型在推理后丢弃自身生成轨迹、且传统上下文学习（ICL）难以泛化的问题，本文提出了一种基于轻量级模块化隐式记忆的在线持续自我提升方法。该方法将推理时计算蒸馏为仅占模型0.001%参数的软提示记忆，并通过测试时自我生成的信号进行高效训练与检索。实验表明，该方法在数学推理任务上表现优异，能有效防止灾难性遗忘并实现跨数据集迁移。
AI.keywords: 持续自我提升 (Continual Self-Improvement), 隐式记忆 (Latent Memories), 推理时计算 (Inference-time Compute), 软提示 (Soft Prompts)
AI.comments:
1. 创新点：本文提出将推理时计算（Inference-time Compute）蒸馏为轻量级软提示隐式记忆的方法，摆脱了传统上下文学习（ICL）对原始推理轨迹（Token级）的重用局限。
2. 重要性：为大语言模型实现高效、无监督的在线持续学习提供了一条新路径，通过模块化设计（仅占0.001%参数）有效解决了持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。
3. 局限性（基于摘要）：该方法依赖于“多数投票”等测试时信号作为奖励，对于不具备明确客观标准答案或无法通过多数投票评估的开放式生成任务，其适用性可能受限。

title: QueryMarket: Cost-Aware Online Active Learning in Data Markets
comments: 10 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
summary: Data acquisition is a major bottleneck for learning in real-time streams: analysts must decide on the fly which labels to purchase while respecting a rolling budget. However, existing online active learning rarely unifies pricing, information gain, and rolling budget constraints under concept drift. We introduce QueryMarket, a market-inspired framework that queries each incoming data point based on its estimated utility to the model and its price. Within this framework, we propose OVBAL (online variance-based active learning), which integrates data pricing with information-driven selection by estimating each sample's marginal utility via a D-optimality criterion with exponential forgetting and executing cost-aware purchases under rolling budget constraints. OVBAL yields a simple, fully online decision rule that adapts to nonstationary streams and heterogeneous label costs. Experiments on synthetic data and a real-world solar power generation forecasting task show that OVBAL is particularly effective under seller-centric pricing and yields a more favorable long-run error-cost trade-off in the real-world task under both pricing schemes.
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems

AI.title_translation: QueryMarket：数据市场中成本感知的在线主动学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了QueryMarket框架和OVBAL算法，在滚动预算约束下融合数据定价与信息增益，实现了非平稳实时数据流中成本感知的在线主动学习。
AI.motivation: 在实时数据流中，数据获取是学习的主要瓶颈。分析师必须在遵守滚动预算的同时，实时决定购买哪些标签。然而，现有的在线主动学习方法很少在概念漂移（concept drift）下统一考虑定价、信息增益和滚动预算约束。
AI.method: 提出QueryMarket框架，根据传入数据点对模型的估计效用及其价格进行查询。在该框架内提出OVBAL（在线基于方差的主动学习）算法，通过带有指数遗忘（exponential forgetting）的D-最优性准则（D-optimality criterion）估计每个样本的边际效用，将数据定价与信息驱动的选择相结合，并在滚动预算约束下执行成本感知的购买。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实世界太阳能发电预测任务上的实验表明，OVBAL在以卖家为中心的定价下特别有效，并且在两种定价方案下，在真实世界任务中都能产生更优的长期误差-成本权衡（error-cost trade-off）。
AI.conclusion: OVBAL提供了一种简单且完全在线的决策规则，能够有效适应非平稳流和异构标签成本，在数据流市场中实现了更优的长期误差与成本权衡。
AI.translation: 数据获取是实时数据流学习中的一个主要瓶颈：分析师必须在遵守滚动预算的同时，实时决定购买哪些标签。然而，现有的在线主动学习很少在概念漂移下统一考虑定价、信息增益和滚动预算约束。我们引入了 QueryMarket，这是一个受市场启发的框架，它根据每个传入数据点对模型的估计效用及其价格来进行查询。在此框架内，我们提出了 OVBAL（基于在线方差的主动学习），该方法通过带有指数遗忘的 D-最优性准则来估计每个样本的边际效用，从而将数据定价与信息驱动的选择相结合，并在滚动预算约束下执行成本感知的购买。OVBAL 产生了一个简单的、完全在线的决策规则，能够适应非平稳流和异构的标签成本。在合成数据和真实世界太阳能发电预测任务上的实验表明，OVBAL 在以卖家为中心的定价下特别有效，并且在两种定价方案下，在真实世界任务中都能产生更有利的长期误差-成本折衷。
AI.summary: 本文针对实时流数据获取中的预算和定价问题，提出了QueryMarket框架及OVBAL算法。该方法通过D-最优性准则和指数遗忘机制评估样本的边际效用，在滚动预算约束下实现了成本感知、完全在线的标签购买决策。实验证明，该方法在非平稳数据流和异构标签成本下表现出色，实现了更优的长期误差-成本权衡。
AI.keywords: 在线主动学习, 数据市场, 滚动预算, 概念漂移, 成本感知
AI.comments: 该论文创造性地将数据市场中的定价机制与在线主动学习相结合，解决了流数据中预算限制、概念漂移和异构成本并存的实际痛点。其提出的OVBAL算法基于D-最优性并引入指数遗忘，数学原理清晰且实用性强，在新能源预测等实际场景中展现了极高的应用价值。

title: Million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy with expert-guided foundation models
comments: 31 pages, 5 main figures, supplementary information included. Submitted to Scientific Reports
summary: Automated pollen identification from microscopy remains a bottleneck in aerobiology, palaeoecology and biodiversity monitoring, because scalable systems must generalise across specimen preparation, scanner settings and geographic origins while retaining palynological interpretability. To address this gap, we present a million-scale multimodal pollen microscopy resource, Pollen AI Atlas, assembled from pure-species whole-slide bright-field images spanning four geographic origins, four scanner settings and 46 taxon labels across 31 botanical families. Seeded by one manually selected exemplar per source slide, token-level mining and filtering produced 1,511,390 released grain detections with 99.6\% proposal precision in expert-curated test regions. Each detection was paired with machine-generated grain-level morphological captions from five open-weight vision-language models, guided by expert-verified palynological anchors, yielding structured descriptions of aperture systems, wall ornamentation, shape and size. Among the evaluated models, Gemma4 provided the most controlled primary caption set, combining tight length control, no leakage and the strongest text-retrieval performance. Baseline benchmarks with frozen visual features reached 88.16\% top-1 accuracy, while cross-regional retrieval showed that caption-derived text embeddings remained robust when image similarity degraded (mAP@20 0.811 versus 0.262). Released data, annotations, captions, splits, code, and weights provide a benchmark for pollen recognition, cross-regional domain adaptation and domain-specific multimodal microscopy learning.
comment: 31 pages, 5 main figures, supplementary information included. Submitted to Scientific Reports

AI.title_translation: 专家引导基础模型的百万级多模态花粉显微学
AI.tldr: 本文推出了Pollen AI Atlas，这是一个包含超150万个花粉颗粒图像及机器生成形态描述的百万级多模态花粉显微数据集，并展示了其在跨区域检索和花粉识别中的强大基准性能。
AI.motivation: 显微镜下的自动花粉识别是气生物学、古生态学和生物多样性监测的瓶颈，因为可扩展系统必须在不同的标本制备、扫描仪设置和地理来源之间进行泛化，同时保持孢粉学的可解释性。
AI.method: 提出百万级多模态花粉显微资源“Pollen AI Atlas”。通过在纯物种全切片明场图像（涵盖4个地理来源、4种扫描仪设置、31个科的46个分类群标签）上，以每个源切片手动选择一个样本为种子，进行Token级挖掘和过滤，产生1,511,390个花粉粒检测。每个检测结果与5个开源视觉语言模型（由专家验证的孢粉学锚点引导）生成的机器形态描述配对，产生关于萌发孔系统、外壁纹饰、形状和大小的结构化描述。
AI.result: 在专家策划的测试区域中，花粉粒检测的建议精确度达到99.6%。使用冻结视觉特征的基线基准达到了88.16%的Top-1准确率。跨区域检索表明，当图像相似度下降时，基于描述生成的文本嵌入仍保持鲁棒性（mAP@20为0.811，而图像相似度仅为0.262）。在评估的模型中，Gemma4提供了最受控的主要描述集，结合了严格的长度控制、无泄漏和最强的文本检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 释放的数据、标注、描述、划分、代码和权重为花粉识别、跨区域领域自适应和领域特定多模态显微学习提供了一个强大的基准。
AI.translation: 显微镜下的自动花粉识别仍然是气生物学、古生态学和生物多样性监测中的一个瓶颈，因为可扩展的系统必须在样本制备、扫描仪设置和地理来源之间进行泛化，同时保持孢粉学的可解释性。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了一个百万级多模态花粉显微资源——Pollen AI Atlas，它由纯物种全切片明场图像组装而成，涵盖了四个地理来源、四种扫描仪设置以及分布在31个植物科中的46个分类群标签。以每个源切片中手动选择的一个样本为种子，通过Token级的挖掘和过滤，在专家策划的测试区域中生成了1,511,390个已发布的、提案精确度达99.6%的花粉粒检测。每个检测结果都与来自五个开源视觉语言模型的机器生成花粉粒级形态描述相配对，这些模型由专家验证的孢粉学锚点引导，从而产生了关于萌发孔系统、外壁纹饰、形状和大小的结构化描述。在评估的模型中，Gemma4提供了最受控的主要描述集，结合了严格的长度控制、无泄漏以及最强的文本检索性能。使用冻结视觉特征的基线基准达到了88.16%的Top-1准确率，而跨区域检索表明，当图像相似度下降时，基于描述生成的文本嵌入仍然保持鲁棒（mAP@20为0.811，而图像相似度为0.262）。发布的数据、标注、描述、划分、代码和权重为花粉识别、跨区域领域自适应以及特定领域的多模态显微学习提供了一个基准。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Pollen AI Atlas，这是一个包含超过150万个花粉粒检测的大规模多模态花粉显微镜数据集。该数据集通过Token级挖掘构建，并利用5个视觉语言模型结合专家引导生成了详细的形态学文本描述。实验表明，该数据集在花粉识别基准上达到了88.16%的准确率，且其文本嵌入在跨区域检索中表现出极强的鲁棒性，为多模态显微学和跨区域领域自适应提供了重要基准。
AI.keywords: 花粉识别, 多模态显微镜, 视觉语言模型, 领域自适应, 孢粉学
AI.comments: 该论文成功构建了首个百万级的多模态花粉显微数据集Pollen AI Atlas，其创新之处在于将专家知识（孢粉学锚点）与先进的视觉语言模型相结合，生成了高质量的结构化文本描述。这不仅解决了传统显微图像可解释性不足的问题，还通过文本嵌入显著提升了跨区域检索的泛化能力。其开源的数据和代码将极大地推动生物多样性监测、古生态学和微体古生物学领域的发展。

title: No-Free-Fairness: Fundamental Limits and Trade-offs in Learning Systems
summary: In this paper, we establish a set of theoretical impossibility results, termed the No-Free-Fairness theorems, that identify three fundamental sources of disparity in learning systems. First, we show that when a task exhibits irreducible cost on a subgroup, any decision rule must trade off overall performance with disparity, yielding an inherent fairness--cost frontier. Second, we prove that even in ideal, noise-free settings where a perfectly fair and accurate solution exists, finite-sample learning alone induces nontrivial subgroup disparity, ruling out distribution-free fairness guarantees. More seriously, enforcing strict relative fairness creates a statistical bottleneck: achieving low cost may require exponentially many samples. Third, we show that limitations of the model class can independently induce disparity: if the model cannot represent accurate solutions for a subgroup, fairness remains unattainable regardless of data or training procedure. Overall, these results demonstrate that unfairness is not solely a consequence of biased data or suboptimal optimization, but arises from the intrinsic structure of decision problems, the constraints of finite data, and the expressivity of models. Our framework applies broadly beyond standard supervised learning, and suggests that achieving fairness requires explicit trade-offs and should be treated as a core design consideration.

AI.title_translation: 无免费公平：学习系统中的基本极限与权衡
AI.tldr: 本文提出了“无免费公平”定理，证明了学习系统中的不公平性源于任务的固有成本、有限样本的学习限制以及模型表达能力的局限性，表明实现公平性必须进行显式的权衡。
AI.motivation: 传统的观点通常将算法的不公平性归咎于偏差数据或次优优化。本文旨在探索学习系统中不公平性的更深层、更本质的来源，并建立关于公平性极限和权衡的理论框架。
AI.method: 提出“无免费公平定理”（No-Free-Fairness theorems）理论框架，从任务的不可约成本、有限样本学习的统计限制以及模型表达能力三个维度，对学习系统中的差异（disparity）进行理论分析与证明。
AI.result: 证明了：（1）当子群体存在不可约成本时，任何决策规则都必须在整体性能与差异之间进行权衡；（2）在有限样本下，即使无噪声也无法保证无分布公平，且严格的相对公平会导致需要指数级样本的统计瓶颈；（3）如果模型无法为某子群体表示准确解，则受限于模型表达能力，公平性无法实现。
AI.conclusion: 不公平性不仅是偏见数据或次优优化的结果，更是由决策问题的内在结构、有限数据的约束以及模型的表达能力所决定的。因此，实现公平性需要进行显式的权衡，并应将其作为系统设计的核心考量。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们建立了一组理论上的不可能结果，称为“无免费公平”（No-Free-Fairness）定理，它确定了学习系统中差异的三个根本来源。首先，我们表明，当一个任务在某个子群体上表现出不可约成本时，任何决策规则都必须在整体性能与差异之间进行权衡，从而产生固有的公平-成本边界。其次，我们证明，即使在存在完美公平且准确解的理想、无噪声设置中，有限样本学习本身也会引起非平凡的子群体差异，从而排除了无分布的公平性保证。更严重的是，实施严格的相对公平会创造一个统计瓶颈：实现低成本可能需要指数级多的样本。第三，我们表明模型类别的局限性可以独立地引起差异：如果模型无法为某个子群体表示准确的解，那么无论数据或训练过程如何，公平性仍然无法实现。总的来说，这些结果表明，不公平不仅是偏见数据或次优优化的结果，而且源于决策问题的内在结构、有限数据的约束以及模型的表达能力。我们的框架广泛适用于标准监督学习之外，并表明实现公平性需要显式的权衡，应被视为核心设计考量。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“无免费公平”（No-Free-Fairness）定理，系统性地阐明了机器学习中不公平性的三大根本来源：任务的内在不可约成本、有限样本学习带来的统计限制以及模型表达能力的局限。研究表明，不公平性不仅源自数据偏差，更是由问题结构和系统约束决定的，因此在设计学习系统时必须将公平性作为需要显式权衡的核心要素。
AI.keywords: 无免费公平, 机器学习极限, 统计瓶颈, 模型表达力, 公平性权衡
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于从理论上对机器学习中的“公平性”给出了类似于“无免费午餐定理”的极限证明。它打破了“只要数据足够好、算法足够优化就能实现完全公平”的直觉，指出了公平性、准确性与样本复杂度之间深刻的内在冲突。这一理论框架为未来公平机器学习算法的设计提供了清晰的边界和指导，具有重要的理论基石意义。

title: UMB: A Unified Markov Binary Format for Probabilistic Model Checking (extended version)
summary: This paper presents the unified Markov binary (UMB) format, an efficient, extensible, and well-supported explicit-state file format for representing a wide range of probabilistic systems. UMB addresses the problem that, while probabilistic model checking tools often support common high-level modelling languages, there is no effective mechanism for exchanging low-level model representations. In practice, textual, tool-specific formats are used, hampering interoperability and resulting in large overheads in writing and reading model files. UMB provides a clean, unified, and efficient solution, based on a general underlying mathematical model, and encoded using a small set of bit-level primitive data structures. The format has already been adopted by prominent tools and comes with a convenient Python library for reading, manipulating, creating, and validating models, plus infrastructure for cross-tool installation and continuous validation. We report on both the efficiency of the file format and the new practical use cases that it facilitates.

AI.title_translation: UMB：一种用于概率模型检测的统一马尔可夫二进制格式（扩展版）
AI.tldr: 本文提出了UMB，一种高效、统一且可扩展的二进制文件格式，旨在解决概率模型检测工具之间低层模型交换困难、读写开销大的问题。
AI.motivation: 虽然现有的概率模型检测工具支持高层建模语言，但缺乏一种有效的机制来交换低层的模型表示。目前主要依赖文本或特定于工具的格式，这阻碍了工具之间的互操作性，并导致读写模型文件时产生巨大的开销。
AI.method: 提出统一马尔可夫二进制（UMB）格式，这是一种用于表示概率系统的显式状态文件格式。它基于通用的底层数学模型，并使用一小套位级原始数据结构进行编码。此外，还开发了配套的Python库（用于读取、操作、创建和验证模型）以及用于跨工具安装和持续验证的基础设施。
AI.result: UMB格式已被主流概率模型检测工具采用。评估结果表明，该文件格式不仅具有极高的读写效率，还促成了许多新的实际应用场景。
AI.conclusion: UMB格式为概率系统的低层模型表示和交换提供了一种干净、统一且高效的解决方案，不仅提高了工具间的互操作性，还大幅降低了文件读写开销，具有很强的实用性。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一种统一马尔可夫二进制（UMB）格式，这是一种高效、可扩展且得到良好支持的显式状态文件格式，用于表示广泛的概率系统。UMB解决了以下问题：虽然概率模型检测工具通常支持常见的高层建模语言，但缺乏交换低层模型表示的有效机制。在实践中，通常使用基于文本、特定于工具的格式，这阻碍了互操作性，并在读写模型文件时带来巨大的开销。UMB提供了一种干净、统一且高效的解决方案，它基于通用的底层数学模型，并使用一小套位级原始数据结构进行编码。该格式已被知名工具采用，并配备了用于读取、操作、创建和验证模型的便捷Python库，以及用于跨工具安装和持续验证的基础设施。我们报告了该文件格式的高效性及其促进的新实际应用场景。
AI.summary: 本文针对概率模型检测中底层模型交换效率低、缺乏统一标准的问题，提出了一种统一马尔可夫二进制（UMB）格式。这是一种高效、可扩展的显式状态文件格式，基于通用数学模型并采用位级原始数据结构编码。UMB已获得主流工具的支持，并配备了方便的Python库及跨工具验证基础设施，有效解决了工具间的互操作性难题。
AI.keywords: 概率模型检测, 统一马尔可夫二进制 (UMB), 文件格式, 互操作性, 显式状态
AI.comments: 这项工作具有很强的实用价值和重要性。其创新点在于通过定义通用的底层数学模型和精简的位级数据结构，为概率系统模型建立了一个统一、高效的二进制交换标准。这有效解决了长期以来概率模型检测工具之间由于使用文本或特定工具格式而导致的互操作性差、读写开销大的痛点。局限性方面，虽然UMB通过二进制编码提高了效率，但作为一种显式状态（explicit-state）格式，在面对超大规模状态空间时，仍可能受到显式表示本身的物理限制。

title: Beyond Native Success: Auditing Deployment-Interface Exposure of CLIP Backdoors
summary: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training models are widely reused across downstream interfaces, including feature extraction, retrieval, reranking, and selection. Existing CLIP backdoor, however, usually validate attacks on a small attack-native task, leaving unclear whether the same poisoned checkpoint remains exposed, weakens, or becomes not applicable when reused through other interfaces. We introduce DIFE, a Deployment-Interface Footprint Evaluation framework that audits backdoored CLIP checkpoints across deployment interfaces. DIFE makes various evaluations comparable by specifying each interface's component readout, trigger channel, target event, reference condition, and metric. DIFE also introduces effective-footprint diagnosis to identify the reusable CLIP component or component combination that carries exposure and explains where risk transfers. Auditing reproduced CLIP backdoors with DIFE reveals a structured landscape: native success is not a checkpoint-level risk certificate, exposure follows component footprints, text-side poisoning does not yield textual-encoder control, and some coupled attacks remain mechanism-bound. This audit reveals a import gapin existing CLIP backdoors: a textual encoder that itself becomes a reusable carrier of adversarial behavior. We therefore introduce BadTextTower to fill this gap. BadTextTower produces strong text-conditioned retrieval, reranking, and selection exposure while leaving visual-only reuse nearly clean.

AI.title_translation: 超越原生成功：审计CLIP后门在部署接口的暴露
AI.tldr: 现有CLIP后门攻击通常只在特定任务上验证，不清楚在其他部署接口中是否依然有效。本文引入DIFE框架来审计CLIP后门在不同部署接口的暴露，并提出了BadTextTower来填补文本编码器作为可重用对抗行为载体的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP后门攻击通常只在小型的“攻击原生”任务上验证，导致不清楚当中毒的检查点通过特征提取、检索、重排序和选择等其他接口重用时，后门是否仍然暴露、减弱或不再适用。此外，现有CLIP后门存在一个重要空白：缺乏使文本编码器本身成为对抗行为的可重用载体的方法。
AI.method: 引入了DIFE (Deployment-Interface Footprint Evaluation) 框架，用于审计后门CLIP检查点在不同部署接口的暴露。DIFE通过指定每个接口的组件读出、触发通道、目标事件、参考条件和度量标准，使各种评估具有可比性，并引入有效足迹诊断以识别风险转移。为填补文本编码器作为可重用对抗行为载体的空白，提出了BadTextTower。
AI.result: 使用DIFE审计再现的CLIP后门揭示：原生成功并非检查点级别的风险证书；暴露遵循组件足迹；文本侧投毒不会产生文本编码器控制；一些耦合攻击仍受机制限制。审计还发现现有CLIP后门在使文本编码器成为可重用对抗行为载体方面存在空白。BadTextTower在文本条件检索、重排序和选择中产生强大的暴露，同时使仅视觉重用几乎干净。
AI.conclusion: 现有CLIP后门在不同部署接口的暴露情况不明确，原生成功并非检查点级别的风险证书。DIFE框架能够有效审计和诊断后门风险转移。本文发现文本编码器作为对抗行为载体的空白，并提出了BadTextTower来填补这一空白，实现了强大的文本侧攻击，同时保持视觉侧的安全性。
AI.translation: 对比语言-图像预训练模型被广泛重用于下游接口，包括特征提取、检索、重排序和选择。然而，现有的CLIP后门通常在小型“攻击原生”任务上验证攻击，导致不清楚当中毒的检查点通过其他接口重用时，后门是否仍然暴露、减弱或不再适用。我们引入了DIFE，一个部署接口足迹评估框架，用于审计后门CLIP检查点在不同部署接口的暴露。DIFE通过指定每个接口的组件读出、触发通道、目标事件、参考条件和度量标准，使各种评估具有可比性。DIFE还引入了有效足迹诊断，以识别携带暴露的可重用CLIP组件或组件组合，并解释风险转移。使用DIFE审计再现的CLIP后门揭示了一个结构化的图景：原生成功并非检查点级别的风险证书，暴露遵循组件足迹，文本侧投毒不会产生文本编码器控制，以及一些耦合攻击仍受机制限制。这项审计揭示了现有CLIP后门的一个重要空白：一个文本编码器本身成为对抗行为的可重用载体。因此，我们引入了BadTextTower来填补这一空白。BadTextTower在文本条件检索、重排序和选择中产生强大的暴露，同时使仅视觉重用几乎干净。
AI.summary: 本文针对CLIP后门攻击在不同部署接口的暴露问题，提出了DIFE框架以审计后门检查点在特征提取、检索等多种接口下的风险。DIFE通过标准化评估参数和引入有效足迹诊断，揭示了原生成功并非风险证书，且暴露与组件足迹相关。研究发现现有CLIP后门在使文本编码器成为可重用对抗载体方面存在不足，为此引入了BadTextTower，实现了强大的文本条件攻击，同时保持视觉侧的清洁性。
AI.keywords: CLIP后门, 部署接口, DIFE框架, 文本编码器攻击, BadTextTower
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入DIFE框架，系统地解决了现有CLIP后门攻击在多接口重用场景下暴露评估不足的问题，具有创新性。其发现“原生成功并非检查点级别的风险证书”对理解后门风险具有重要意义。BadTextTower的提出填补了文本编码器作为独立对抗载体的空白，拓展了CLIP后门攻击的范围和深度，对未来的模型安全研究具有指导价值。

title: Conservation Laws for Modern Neural Architectures
comments: Published at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Understanding gradient descent dynamics is key to explaining the success of over-parameterized models, where implicit bias manifests through conservation laws in gradient flow. While such laws are well understood for linear and ReLU networks, they remain largely unexplored for modern architectures. This work develops a unified framework to characterize conservation laws for contemporary models, including feedforward networks with GELU, SiLU, and SwiGLU activations, multihead attention with sinusoidal and rotary positional encodings, and Mixture-of-Experts architectures under diverse gating designs. Our theoretical findings are supported by experiments that validate the predicted invariants.
